title: Architect
description:
**We’re Hiring: Architect (with a strong interest in Landscape Design)**

**Location:** Hyderabad | **Type:** Full-Time | **Experience:** 1–2 Years

We are looking for a passionate and creative **Architect** to join our design-driven studio, where nature, water, and outdoor living meet cutting-edge design. This role is ideal for someone who has a strong interest in **landscape design and outdoor spatial planning**.

**Role & Responsibilities:**

* Collaborate on landscape layout planning for luxury outdoor spaces, including ponds, water features, hardscape elements, and plantations
* Conduct site studies and prepare concept designs, mood boards, and reference palettes
* Work closely with the design head to research plant species, soil suitability, microclimates, and plantation sequencing
* Assist in positioning of trees, pathways, stone arrangements, and other outdoor features
* Prepare detailed plant & material lists and coordinate with vendors and nurseries for sourcing
* Attend high-level client and architect meetings to understand requirements and explain design intent
* Coordinate with the internal 3D team for visuals and ensure design alignment
* Stay involved from concept to execution phase, ensuring on-site design integrity
* Keep up with global landscape and ecological design trends for continuous inspiration and R&D

**Required Skills:**

* Bachelor's degree in Architecture (B.Arch)
* A keen eye for nature-based design, spatial harmony, and material selection
* Strong communication and presentation skills
* Proficiency in AutoCAD, SketchUp, Photoshop, and basic knowledge of Lumion or similar software
* Willingness to travel for site visits and plant sourcing trips when needed
* Passion for outdoor aesthetics and natural material detailing

**Bonus if you have:**

* Prior experience or academic projects in landscape architecture or outdoor design
* Interest in exotic plants, native species, or ecological planning
* Hand sketching or quick ideation skills

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent

Pay: ₹35,000.00 - ₹40,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Commuter assistance

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Shaikpet, Hyderabad, Telangana: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Preferred)

Application Question(s):

* Have you read the description before applying?

Education:

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

Experience:

* Layout design: 2 years (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

title: AM Public-Hyderabad-Vice President-Software Engineering
description:
**What We Do**

At Goldman Sachs, we connect people, capital and ideas to help solve problems for our clients. We are a leading global financial services firm providing investment banking, securities and investment management services to a substantial and diversified client base that includes corporations, financial institutions, governments and individuals.

**Who are we**

Goldman Sachs Engineers are innovators and problem-solvers, building solutions in risk management, big data, mobile and more. We look for creative collaborators who evolve, adapt to change and thrive in a fast-paced global environment. The Digital Client Experience teams in Asset Management provide clients with innovative and customer-centered financial products to drive transformative changes. We bring the best qualities of a technology player and combine that with the best attributes of a large bank. Our Digital teams comprise of three main businesses, underpinned by engineering, product operations, security and risk management:

* **Mosaic**, an end-to-end open architecture technology platform and a digital product that provides trading, settlement, analytics, and reporting solutions to global liquidity clients.

* **GSAM.com**: GSAM is the asset management arm of Goldman Sachs, which supervises more than $1.8 trillion in assets. Goldman Sachs Asset Management has been providing discretionary investment advisory services since 1988 and has investment professionals in all major financial centers around the world.

Our team of engineers builds solutions to the most complex problems. We develop cutting-edge digital platform and processes that form the core of our key business and enable several marketing and sales. We develop global web and mobile platform for Third Party Distribution and Institutional businesses. Team members have the opportunity to work at the forefront of technology innovation alongside industry leaders and make significant contributions to the field.

* **Advisor Portal** : An external Advisor Portal is a key component of SMA expansion program. The aim of this portal is to provide an all-digital, best in class experience to Advisors such as advisor onboarding, application for new SMAs, track accounts status, access advisor tools etc. Retail distribution requires scaling our client onboarding and portfolio management to support tens of thousands of clients through diligence, onboarding, and ongoing lifecycle events.

Join us on our journey to deliver financial products and platforms that prioritize the customer and developer experience.

**Digital Client Experience Engineering**

Digital Client Experience Engineering teams build transformative cutting-edge digital platform and processes that form the core of our key business across liquidity, marketing and sales. Our growth is driven by a relentless focus on our people, our clients and customers, and leading-edge technology, data and design principals.

As an engineer on the Digital Client Experience team, you will have the opportunity to work at the forefront of technology innovation alongside industry leaders and make significant contributions to the field. You will be one the main drivers helping evolve our product strategy as we continue to ensure we are a market leader. This will involve you being asked to come up with creative and commercial solutions to the various problems the team is tackling, and also for us to be able to lean on your leadership when executing those choices.

We are looking for engineers who can drive a whole feature from design to execution, as well as engineers who can deep dive why an API is taking half a second longer than it should. Our team has a large variety of problems to tackle across the entire stack.

**Responsibilities**

As a full stack developer you will

* Drive the design of critical components in the technology stack as well as oversee the implementation of new features, focusing on code quality, automation and testability.
* Collaborate with a global cross functional team in building customer-centric products
* Contribute to the vision, understand our product roadmap and contribute to building an engineering culture within our global team.
* Design flows and systems using cloud and on-prem technologies to ensure performance, longevity, and scalability of infrastructure.
* Contribute to SDLC documentation and guidance including templates, patterns, and controls.
* Perform code reviews and system design reviews and establish code quality standards and software best practices for a distributed systems architecture.
* Mentor and help develop more junior technical talents.
* Communicate with leadership, engineers, and business teams.

We are looking for someone with lots of energy that enjoys engineering challenges and has a passion to deliver high quality technology solutions and is able to operate in a highly fluid, rapidly changing environment.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 12 yrs of work experience.
* Experience with Java, JavaScript, and Spring Boot
* Bachelor’s degree (U.S. or foreign equivalent) in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Experience with design and implementation of low latency, high throughput, and fault-tolerant distributed systems.
* Experience with microservices architecture and API development.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Culture of excellence and collaboration
* Comfort with Agile operating models
* Energetic, self-directed, and self-motivated

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands on experience with Java and experience with any of the Rx\* variants
* Experience with Kafka or similar messaging technologies
* Experience with microservice architectures
* Experience with the Spring framework family
* Strong proficiency in: Distributed systems, Low-latency services, NoSQL and relational databases
* Experience with AWS
* Hands on experience with React and/or Angular
* Experience with external facing websites is a plus
* Experience working with clients / users a plus
* Experience with Adobe Experience Manager is a plus
  

**Goldman Sachs Engineering Culture**

At Goldman Sachs, our Engineers don’t just make things – we make things possible. Change the world by connecting people and capital with ideas. Solve the most challenging and pressing engineering problems for our clients. Join our engineering teams that build massively scalable software and systems, architect low latency infrastructure solutions, proactively guard against cyber threats, and leverage machine learning alongside financial engineering to continuously turn data into action. Create new businesses, transform finance, and explore a world of opportunity at the speed of markets.

Engineering is at the critical center of our business, and our dynamic environment requires innovative strategic thinking and immediate, real solutions. Want to push the limit of digital possibilities? Start here!

We Offer Best-In-Class Benefits

Healthcare & Medical Insurance

We offer a wide range of health and welfare programs that vary depending on office location. These generally include medical, dental, short-term disability, long-term disability, life, accidental death, labor accident and business travel accident insurance.

Holiday & Vacation Policies

We offer competitive vacation policies based on employee level and office location. We promote time off from work to recharge by providing generous vacation entitlements and a minimum of three weeks expected vacation usage each year.

Financial Wellness & Retirement

We assist employees in saving and planning for retirement, offer financial support for higher education, and provide a number of benefits to help employees prepare for the unexpected. We offer live financial education and content on a variety of topics to address the spectrum of employees’ priorities.

Health Services

We offer a medical advocacy service for employees and family members facing critical health situations, and counseling and referral services through the Employee Assistance Program (EAP). We provide Global Medical, Security and Travel Assistance and a Workplace Ergonomics Program. We also offer state-of-the-art on-site health centers in certain offices.

Fitness

To encourage employees to live a healthy and active lifestyle, some of our offices feature on-site fitness centers. For eligible employees we typically reimburse fees paid for a fitness club membership or activity (up to a pre-approved amount).

Child Care & Family Care

We offer on-site child care centers that provide full-time and emergency back-up care, as well as mother and baby rooms and homework rooms. In every office, we provide advice and counseling services, expectant parent resources and transitional programs for parents returning from parental leave. Adoption, surrogacy, egg donation and egg retrieval stipends are also available.

Benefits at Goldman Sachs

Read more about the full suite of class-leading benefits our firm has to offer.

title: Forward Deployed Solution Engineer - CONNECT Data Services
description:
**AVEVA is creating software trusted by over 90% of leading industrial companies.**

**Job Title:** Forward Deployed Solution Engineer - CONNECT Data Services

**Location:** Hyderabad, India

**Employment Type:** Full time, regular, hybrid work arrangement

**The job**

  

The Forward Deployed Solution Engineer owns a defined technical workstream within an FDE engagement. Working within agreed architecture and standards, the role applies customer domain context to configure, integrate, test, troubleshoot, validate, document, and hand over AVEVA solutions using real customer data, systems, and constraints. The role is accountable for quality, timelines, reusable technical outputs, and timely risk escalation.

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Own a defined FDE technical workstream from implementation through validation and handover.
* Build, configure, integrate, test, troubleshoot, and adapt AVEVA solutions in real customer environments.
* Apply established architecture, standards, methods, and governance to deliver reliable outcomes.
* Clarify requirements, dependencies, risks, feasibility, and implementation needs for the workstream.
* Implement creative and out of the box solutioning strategies against identified product feature gaps
* Resolve non-routine technical issues across APIs, integrations, data flows, configuration, performance, security, and deployment.
* Support demonstrations, acceptance testing, performance checks, validation, and production-readiness activities.
* Create reusable configurations, connectors, templates, AI patterns, implementation notes, and troubleshooting guidance.
* Coordinate with peers and adjacent teams, guide less-experienced contributors where appropriate, and escalate material risks early.

**Essential Skills**

  

* Typically, 5-8 years of relevant experience, or equivalent demonstrated capability in industrial technology implementation and technical project delivery.
* Hands-on capability in AVEVA solution configuration, integration, testing, troubleshooting, validation, and handover.
* Working knowledge of AVEVA products, customer domain workflows, industrial data, customer systems, APIs, cloud/edge, security, performance, and deployment constraints.
* Practical domain awareness of the customer’s operating model, workflows, KPIs, and value drivers, so the solution solves the right industrial problem.
* Ability to work within agreed architecture, standards, methodologies, governance, and engagement priorities.
* Sound judgment in resolving non-routine technical issues and escalating risks early.
* Clear customer-facing and cross-team communication skills.
* Developing AI Agents, Skills, Tools, Plugins etc. using any one of the agentic framework preferably MAF
* AI tools for SDLC like Copilot & practical awareness of AI/ML and Generative AI use cases within agreed technical, safety, and governance guidance.
* Accountability for quality, schedule, documentation, testing evidence, reusable outputs, and reliable handover.

**What Success Looks Like**

  

* Defined FDE technical workstreams are delivered reliably, on time, and in line with agreed architecture, standards, and customer success criteria.
* AVEVA solutions are configured, integrated, tested, validated, documented, and handed over with clear evidence of quality and operational readiness.
* Non-routine technical issues are resolved using sound judgment, with material risks, dependencies, and trade-offs escalated early.
* Reusable configurations, templates, troubleshooting notes, implementation guidance, and AI or integration patterns improve delivery quality for future FDE engagements.
* Peers, Architects, Leads, and customer-facing stakeholders view the role as a dependable technical contributor who builds confidence through practical execution, clear communication, and reliable handover.

**Services at AVEVA**

Our dynamic global team of 700+ engineers, developers, consultants, solution architects and project managers are at the forefront of delivering AVEVA cutting-edge solutions to customers. The work is complex and technical, but immensely rewarding: we empower customers to harness the full transformative potential of AVEVA’s solutions. If you’re analytical, pragmatic, and driven to make a tangible impact on the sustainability of the industrial sector, our team is the perfect place for you.

You’ll also be joining an award-winning workplace. AVEVA is Great Place to Work® Certified™ in multiple countries, reflecting the culture our people create every day. Explore our awards and recognition.

Find out more: https://www.aveva.com/en/about/careers/

Gratuity, Medical and accidental insurance, very attractive leave entitlement, emergency leave days, childcare support, maternity, paternity and adoption leaves, education assistance program, home office set up support (for hybrid roles), well-being support

Some positions are fully office-based depending on the nature of the work, and certain roles that support specific customers or markets may be remote. Job Description
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  

* Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.
* Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.
* Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the worlds greatest health threats.

Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our company’s IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
  
  
A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.
  
  
**What will you do in this role:**  

* Enterprise Technical Leadership: Serves as asenior technical leader and key advisor for data engineering, partnering with Enterprise Architecture to co-create technical vision, data blueprints, and engineering standards across the organization.
* Complex Pipeline Architecture: Leads the design and implementation of highly complex, end-to-end data pipeline architectures utilizing IDMC (Informatica Intelligent Data Management Cloud), Databricks, and AWS to support global commercial and manufacturing analytics.
* Enterprise Platform Strategy: Establishes best-practice architectures for Databricks Lakehouses (Unity Catalog, Delta Lake optimization) and highly secure AWS infrastructures.
* Salesforce Veeva Ecosystem Mastery: Champions the architectural strategy for massive data replication, migration, and synchronization between Salesforce (e.g., Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud, Veeva CRM) and downstream analytical platforms.
* Data Integration ETL Governance: Owns the enterprise architecture for IDMC, defining patterns for secure agents, high-throughput mappings, reusable taskflows, and hybrid cloud integration strategies.
* Cross-Functional Architecture Alignment: Collaborates intensively with principal architects, product owners, and commercial business leads to translate corporate objectives into robust, compliant, and scalable technical solutions.
* Compliance Quality Standards: Holds ultimate accountability for the technical compliance, data quality, and security of delivered assets, ensuring strict adherence to SDLC software validation, privacy laws, and security protocols.
* Innovation Advanced Technology RD: Spearheads technical exploration, prototyping, and proof-of-concept initiatives for emerging trends such as real-time streaming, generative AI pipeline components, and automated data quality monitoring.
* Mentorship Talent Cultivation: Mentors senior engineering talent and guides engineering squads, raising the collective technical capability and establishing a strongcommunity of practice.

Primary skills (must-have)
  
  

* Principal-Level Programming: Mastery of programing languages and advanced SQL; deep understanding of memory management, cluster configuration, and query tuning in distributed systems.
* Enterprise IDMC Architecture: Demonstrated expertise in designing large-scale integration solutions using Informatica Intelligent Data Management Cloud (IDMC), including API management, performance tuning, and Secure Agent architecture.
* Databricks Lakehouse Mastery: Advanced experience structuring enterprise Lakehouses, managing global schema permissions via Unity Catalog, and optimizing read/write speeds using Delta Lake configurations.
* AWS Cloud Engineering: Mastery in building serverless cloud architectures on AWS using Infrastructure as Code and orchestrating services like S3, Lambda, IAM, and Step Functions.
* Salesforce Commercial Analytics Integration: Proven track record of architecting high-volume synchronization processes from Salesforce/Veeva CRM to central warehouses while preserving performance and data integrity.
* Enterprise Data Modeling: Industry-leading expertise in dimensional modeling, data lake design patterns, Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD), and semantic layer architecture.
* Compliance Validation Governance: Solid understanding of data privacy frameworks, commercial compliance standards, and SDLC validation workflows.
* Technical Influence Advisory: Outstanding ability to communicate technical roadmaps, architectural risks, and complex trade-offs to senior leadership, and business stakeholders.

description:
**Req ID:** 396555
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Enterprise Product - Engineer to join our team in Hyderabad, Telangana (IN-TG), India (IN).
  
  
**Job Description:**  
We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior Software Engineer to join our Enterprise Product team focused on Product Data Master (PDM), Product Information Management (PIM), Product Catalog, and Product Configuration systems.
  
  
This role will design, develop, and operate scalable enterprise solutions that serve as the foundation for product data across ERP, PLM, CPQ, eCommerce, DAM, and other enterprise platforms. You will partner with product managers, architects, and global engineering teams to deliver secure, reliable, and scalable solutions that enable business growth and operational excellence.
  
  
What You'll Do
  

* Design, develop, and operate scalable Product Data Master (PDM), PIM, Product Catalog, and Product Configuration platforms on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
* Build and support integrations between Product Data Master and enterprise platforms including ERP, PLM, CPQ, DAM, CMS, eCommerce, and distributor systems.
* Develop microservices, REST APIs, and event-driven workflows that process and distribute product data across multiple platforms.
* Own software delivery end-to-end, including infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD pipelines, Kubernetes deployments, monitoring, and operational support.
* Write automated tests as part of shipping, not as a follow-up.
* Build observable systems using logging, metrics, tracing, and telemetry.
* Build data-driven capabilities that improve product intelligence, catalog completeness, and operational efficiency.
* Review peer code, mentor engineers, and contribute to engineering best practices.
* Partner with product managers, architects, and business stakeholders to translate business needs into scalable technical solutions.

What We're Looking For
  

* 8+ years of experience building and operating enterprise software products in production environments.
* Strong understanding of object-oriented design, SOLID principles, design patterns, and distributed system architecture.
* Deep fluency in at least one modern backend language and the ability to learn another quickly. We build primarily in C#/.NET, so that is ideal. Strong Java, Go, or Kotlin engineers who are willing to work in C# are equally welcome.
* Experience building microservices, REST APIs, and event-driven architecture.
* Hands-on production experience with Azure, Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD, and cloud-native operations.
* Experience integrating enterprise applications using APIs and modern integration patterns.
* Experience with relational and NoSQL databases, data modeling, and scalable data platforms.
* Comfort owning infrastructure, deployment pipelines, and operational support responsibilities.
* Strong troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills.
* Genuine interest in the engineering domain. Curiosity about how products are designed, revised, and released matters more here than it does on most teams.
* Clear writing. Design notes and runbooks are part of the job.
* Authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.

Nice to Have
  

* Experience with Product Data Management (PDM), Product Information Management (PIM), Product Catalog, Pricing, CPQ, DAM, or MDM platforms.
* Experience building product master data platforms, including taxonomy, classification, attributes, and product relationships.
* Experience integrating ERP, PLM, PIM, CPQ, DAM, CMS, and eCommerce platforms.
* Experience with Elasticsearch, Databricks, Graph databases, and analytics platforms.
* Experience applying AI/Generative AI to catalog intelligence, metadata enrichment, classification, or attribute generation.
* Experience with Agile delivery methodologies and globally distributed teams.
* Experience with observability and reporting tools such as Grafana and Power BI.

On AI-Assisted Development
  
  
We expect our engineers to use AI tooling and get real leverage from it across implementation, debugging, testing, and documentation. The order matters: strong fundamentals first, AI as an accelerant second.
  
  
About NTT DATA
  
  
NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. As a Salesforce QA Analyst, you will support the quality assurance lifecycle for Salesforce solutions that enable commercial business processes across the Americas. This role is responsible for test planning, test execution, defect management, release validation, and continuous improvement of quality practices to ensure Salesforce solutions meet business, functional, and technical requirements.

* Perform functional, system, integration, regression, smoke, and end-to-end testing across Salesforce solutions.
* Validate Salesforce configuration, security, automation, and custom functionality including Flows, Apex, Lightning Web Components, profiles, and permission models.
* Test integrations between Salesforce and external systems using APIs and batch-processing interfaces.
* Log, track, retest, and report defects using Agile delivery and defect-management tools.

Collaborate with business analysts, developers, architects, product owners, and business users to ensure quality throughout the delivery lifecycle.

* Experience with functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing methodologies.
* Experience using Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar defect-management tools in Agile/Scrum environments.

Salesforce Administrator, Salesforce Platform App Builder, or related Salesforce certification.

title: PostgreSQL Architect
description:
Job Location (Short): Hyderabad, India

Workplace Type: Hybrid

Req Id: 3453

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

We are seeking an experienced PostgreSQL Architect to design, migrate, and optimize enterprise databases from Oracle and SQL Server to PostgreSQL. The ideal candidate will have strong experience designing high-transaction, multi-tenant PostgreSQL environments and leading complex database migrations with minimal downtime.This role requires a cloud-agnostic mindset. Candidates may have experience with PostgreSQL on any cloud platform or in self-managed environments. They should be able to design solutions that support portability while making informed use of cloud-managed database services where appropriate.

  

**PostgreSQL Development and Performance**

* Design scalable and reliable PostgreSQL architectures for high-volume transactional workloads, with a cloud-agnostic way
* Define strategies for indexing, partitioning, connection pooling, replication, and query optimization
* Analyze query execution plans and tune database performance, including autovacuum, locking, concurrency, and resource utilization
* Perform capacity planning and establish performance benchmarks for production workloads
* Define database architecture standards, coding guidelines, naming conventions, and technical review processes.

**Database Migration**

* Lead end-to-end migrations from Oracle and/or SQL Server to PostgreSQL, including discovery, assessment, schema conversion, data migration, validation, and cutover
* Assess source databases for compatibility gaps, migration complexity, technical dependencies, and performance risks
* Convert and refactor database objects, including stored procedures, functions, triggers, sequences, views, packages, and custom types
* Translate PL/SQL or T-SQL logic into appropriate PostgreSQL solutions using PL/pgSQL and other suitable approaches
* Define migration strategies, including big-bang, phased, or parallel-run approaches, with rollback plans and downtime requirements
* Work with QA and application teams to perform data reconciliation, functional testing, and performance benchmarking.

**Multi-Tenant Design**

* Design PostgreSQL solutions using appropriate tenant isolation models, such as database-per-tenant, schema-per-tenant, or shared schema with row-level security
* Evaluate each model for security, performance, scalability, operational complexity, and cost
* Establish tenant-aware monitoring, capacity planning, backup, and recovery practices.

**Cloud and Operations**

* Architect PostgreSQL deployments on any cloud platform, including managed PostgreSQL services or self-managed installations on virtual machines or Kubernetes
* Design for portability across cloud environments, while documenting any dependencies on provider-specific services or features
* Define high availability, backup, point-in-time recovery, disaster recovery, and replication strategies based on business requirements
* Partner with Cloud Operations and Security teams on monitoring, patching, access control, auditing, incident response, and cost optimization
* Develop automation and operational runbooks for deployment, migration, validation, backup, and recovery.

**Collaboration and Leadership**

* Collaborate with developers on data access patterns, ORM configuration, transaction handling, and query design
* Document architecture decisions, migration plans, risks, and technical trade-offs
* Mentor DBAs and engineers and help build PostgreSQL capabilities across the team

#LI-SD1

**Education / Qualifications**
------------------------------

* 8 or more years of experience in database engineering, with at least 4 years of substantial hands-on PostgreSQL experience
* Proven experience designing and supporting PostgreSQL databases for high-volume transactional workloads or large datasets
* Hands-on experience migrating databases from Oracle and/or SQL Server to PostgreSQL
* Strong proficiency in PostgreSQL SQL and PL/pgSQL, with experience reading and converting PL/SQL or T-SQL
* Experience designing and operating multi-tenant database environments
* Deep understanding of query planning, indexing, partitioning, vacuum and autovacuum, locking, concurrency, and connection management
* Experience designing and supporting replication, high availability, backup, restore, and point-in-time recovery
* Experience running PostgreSQL in at least one cloud environment. Experience on any cloud provider is acceptable
* Strong scripting or automation skills using SQL, Bash, or Python
* Experience in Kubernetes and Containers platform
* Strong troubleshooting, documentation, communication, and cross-team collaboration skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with migration tools such as AWS Schema Conversion Tool, AWS DMS, ora2pg, pgloader, or Azure Database Migration Service
* Experience with managed PostgreSQL services such as Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL or RDS for PostgreSQL, Azure Database for PostgreSQL, or Google Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL
* Experience with PostgreSQL backup and recovery using AWS Backup for supported resources, other cloud-native backup services, or PostgreSQL-native utilities
* Experience with self-managed PostgreSQL on Linux virtual machines, containers, or Kubernetes
* Familiarity with connection poolers such as PgBouncer and monitoring tools such as pg\_stat\_statements, Prometheus, or Grafana
* Experience identifying alternatives for Oracle- or SQL Server-specific features during migration
* Experience in regulated environments with database security, auditing, and compliance requirements
Relevant database or cloud certifications are a plus.  

**Core Competencies**

* Architectural judgment: Balances performance, scalability, cost, security, maintainability, and migration risk
* Ownership: Takes responsibility from architecture and migration through production readiness and support
* Collaboration: Works effectively across DBA, Development, QA, Security, and Cloud Operations teams
* Communication: Clearly explains technical decisions and trade-offs to different audiences
* Mentorship: Shares knowledge and strengthens PostgreSQL skills across the organization.

**About Octave**
----------------

Octave provides mission-critical software that empowers organizations to make informed decisions across every stage of the asset lifecycle - Design, Build, Operate and Protect - where performance, safety, and reliability are non-negotiable and failure is not an option.

Turning complex operational data into actionable intelligence, Octave connects expertise, real-world conditions and enterprise-scale insight to improve performance, resilience and incident response where it matters most.

Octave has more than 7,000 employees in 45 countries. Learn more at octave.com and follow us on LinkedIn.

**Why work for Octave?**
------------------------

All in. Always forward. That's the way we do things around here. We put trust in our people because we believe it's the best way to unleash potential, bring ideas to life, and keep moving ahead. And it's why we're committed to creating an environment that's truly supportive, providing you with the resources you need to support your ambitions, no matter who you are or where you are in the world.

**Everyone is welcome**
-----------------------

At Octave, we believe that diverse and inclusive teams are critical to the success of our people and our business. Here, everyone is welcome. As an inclusive workplace, we don't discriminate. In fact, we embrace differences and are fully committed to creating equal opportunities, an inclusive environment, and fairness for all.

Respect is the cornerstone of how we operate, so speak up and be yourself. You're valued here.

### **Recruitment Fraud Alert**

Octave posts all official job opportunities on either https://careers.octave.com/ or https://www.octave.com/about/careers and communicates only from email addresses ending in @octave.com. We never request payment or personal banking information during recruitment. No offers will ever be extended without a proper interview via Teams or in person, never done over email alone. If you suspect fraud, it probably is, and contact us at careers@octave.com

title: IT System Owner, Electronic Laboratory Notebook (ELN)
description:
**IT System Owner, Electronic Laboratory Notebook (ELN)**

**Location:** Hyderabad, India

Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across three continents. While we work in science, there's no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world.

We are looking for an **IT System Owner, Electronic Laboratory Notebook (ELN)** to provide strategic and operational ownership of Lonza's global Electronic Laboratory Notebook landscape, including **IDBS E-WorkBook** and **Revvity Signals Notebook**. This role ensures reliable, secure, scalable, and compliant ELN services that support Research & Development and Process Development activities across Lonza's Business Platforms and global sites. As a trusted technology partner, the individual will collaborate closely with Global Business Process Owners, scientific stakeholders, vendors, and IT teams to drive platform performance, support digital laboratory transformation, and contribute to the future ELN strategy and roadmap.

**What You'll Get**

* A global technology leadership role supporting Lonza's laboratory informatics ecosystem
* The opportunity to drive the strategic evolution of Electronic Laboratory Notebook platforms across multiple business areas
* Direct collaboration with scientific, operational, and technology leaders across the organization
* Exposure to large-scale digital transformation initiatives within Research & Development and Process Development
* The opportunity to influence technology roadmaps, platform standardization, and laboratory digitalization strategies
* Experience working with advanced laboratory informatics solutions, integrations, and data-driven scientific workflows
* A collaborative global environment focused on innovation, continuous improvement, and operational excellence
* Competitive compensation and benefits aligned with role and experience
* Ongoing professional development and exposure to global projects and emerging technologies

**What You'll Do**

**ELN Platform Ownership & Service Management**

* Act as one of the IT System Owners for Lonza's global ELN landscape, sharing responsibility for technical availability, service performance, security, compliance, and lifecycle management of IDBS E-WorkBook and Revvity Signals Notebook
* Ensure ELN systems remain reliable, scalable, and fit for business needs across Research & Development and Process Development functions
* Monitor platform performance, coordinate maintenance activities, troubleshoot issues, and implement sustainable enhancements
* Maintain effective configuration, change, release, documentation, and service management processes aligned with enterprise standards
* Serve as the technical escalation point for major incidents and service disruptions, coordinating resolution efforts with internal and external stakeholders

**ELN Transformation & Project Delivery**

* Play a key role in the global rollout and adoption of Revvity Signals Notebook across Lonza
* Contribute to requirements gathering, solution design, system configuration, integrations, validation, testing, deployment, and operational readiness activities
* Lead assigned workstreams and technical initiatives to ensure successful project execution
* Support transition of new capabilities into steady-state operations while maintaining service quality and user adoption
* Partner with technical specialists and fellow system owners to build cross-platform capability and eliminate platform silos

**Compliance, Security & Governance**

* Ensure compliance with applicable GxP, data integrity, cybersecurity, access management, and validation requirements
* Apply risk-based controls according to the regulatory classification and operational criticality of each implementation
* Maintain audit readiness and support periodic reviews, inspections, and compliance assessments
* Create, review, and approve system documentation in accordance with applicable policies and procedures
* Drive adherence to enterprise governance standards for laboratory systems and digital platforms

**Stakeholder Engagement & Business Partnership**

* Partner with Global Business Process Owners, business platforms, and site stakeholders to understand evolving requirements and priorities
* Translate scientific and operational business needs into sustainable technology solutions
* Support business adoption through effective communication, change management, and user engagement
* Collaborate with laboratory informatics teams, enterprise architects, vendors, and service providers to optimize platform value
* Foster strong relationships across global, matrixed teams to drive alignment and successful outcomes

**Roadmap, Innovation & Continuous Improvement**

* Define and maintain the ELN technology roadmap, including upgrades, integrations, migrations, standardization initiatives, and platform rationalization activities
* Evaluate new technologies and capabilities that enhance laboratory productivity, collaboration, and digital scientific workflows
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that optimize performance, user experience, and operational efficiency
* Develop recommendations for governance forums and leadership teams regarding future platform direction and investment priorities
* Contribute to broader Laboratory Management Systems and Enterprise Solutions strategies

**Vendor & Financial Management**

* Manage operational supplier relationships, licensing agreements, renewals, service levels, and support models
* Monitor vendor performance and ensure delivery against contractual commitments
* Provide input into annual budgeting and forecasting activities
* Support lifecycle cost planning, project investment evaluations, capacity planning, and cost optimization initiatives
* Identify opportunities to improve value realization while maintaining system quality and compliance

**What We're Looking For**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Biotechnology, Life Sciences, Engineering, or a related discipline
* 8+ years of experience in IT application ownership, laboratory informatics, scientific systems, enterprise applications, or related technology roles
* Strong experience with application lifecycle management, IT service management, and enterprise system ownership
* Understanding of Electronic Laboratory Notebook platforms, laboratory informatics, and scientific workflows supporting Research & Development or Process Development
* Experience with **IDBS E-WorkBook**, **Revvity Signals Notebook**, or comparable laboratory informatics platforms is highly desirable
* Knowledge of system architecture, integrations, security, data flows, and operational support practices
* Experience participating in enterprise software implementations, upgrades, migrations, and digital transformation initiatives
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to manage operational support and project delivery simultaneously
* Proven ability to collaborate effectively with global stakeholders, vendors, and cross-functional teams in a matrix organization
* Strong communication skills with the ability to engage scientific, technical, operational, and leadership audiences
* Financial awareness and experience supporting budgets, forecasts, vendor management, and investment planning
* Understanding of GxP environments, computerized system validation, regulated change control, and data integrity requirements is highly preferred
* Experience working within highly regulated industries such as life sciences, pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, or healthcare is advantageous
* Business-fluent English required
* Willingness to travel internationally on an occasional basis

**Work Model**

This is an **office-first role**. Working together in person supports close, real-time collaboration and team alignment, enabling us to deliver our best work. You will work primarily in the office, with the flexibility to work remotely for up to **20% of your time (one day per week)**.

**What We Offer**

* An agile career and dynamic working culture
* An inclusive and ethical workplace
* Compensation programs that recognize high performance
* A variety of benefits dependent on role and location
* Opportunities to lead digital laboratory transformation initiatives within a global life sciences organization
* Global exposure and collaboration across Research & Development, Process Development, and Enterprise IT functions
* Professional development through innovative technology programs and strategic business projects

The full list of our global benefits can be found here: Lonza Benefits.

**About Lonza**

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With more than 30 sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of **Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion, and Integrity** guide how we work and succeed together.

Everyone's ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives. Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. Lonza is committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can grow, lead, and make a meaningful impact.

**Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.**

title: Manager - IT Program Management
description:
Hyderabad, Telangana

**Requisition ID** 2026-128257 **Category** Project Management, Product Management **Position type** Regular

  

**Your opportunity**
--------------------

  
  

At Charles Schwab, our purpose is simple: we champion client’s goals with passion and integrity. Guided by honesty, mutual respect and a commitment to doing what’s right, we bring innovation, education, and service together to help shape financial futures. Our people are the foundation of our success – they approach their work with curiosity and collaboration, coming together to create solutions that make a meaningful impact for clients and communities. As we expand into India, we are bringing this same culture of inclusion, learning, and opportunity to new talent. Joining us means becoming part of a global team where your work matters and your future can take shape.

Our Hyderabad location is central to Schwab’s growth, bringing together talented people and technology to drive innovation, scale and efficiency. Here, you will work alongside teams who create solutions that support millions of clients every day. The work you do is more than daily operations – it’s a chance to experiment, learn, and build within a values-driven, supportive environment. This is a unique opportunity to be part of our early growth phase and shape something new, backed by the stability and strength of a Fortune 500 company. Your impact begins on day one, and your contributions will help define our future in the region
  
  
The Schwab Asset Management (SAM) Technology organization is a part of Schwab Technology Services that is responsible for Schwab's investment management, operations, data, and research platforms. Everything that SAM Tech builds serves Schwab’s mission of helping clients reach their financial goals.

**What you have**
-----------------

  
  

**Key Responsbilities**

As a Quantitative Analyst - Investment Research in the SAM Investment Research Technology group, you will play a critical role in delivering cutting-edge research and product development capabilities designed to advance SAM business opportunities and to support the Schwab Center for Financial Research (SCFR) in its mission to provide clients and advisors actionable investment advice. We curate structured and unstructured datasets for both exploratory and product-focused research, and we implement and maintain investment models across multiple asset classes and product categoriess, including equity and fund ratings, thematic investing baskets, multi-asset solutions, factor strategies, and more.
  
  
This role will interact with researchers and other business users to help bring together data, analytics, modeling, and operational capabilities into a common ecosystem for all research teams. You will help establish the foundational capabilities, frameworks, and workflows that enable innovative research products, accelerate time-to-market, and promote greater reuse of data and technology assets across the organization. This is an opportunity to help define the future state of quantitative research technology at Schwab.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**

* Degree in computer science, information systems, mathematics, engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience
* Five or more years of business systems analysis and/or software engineering experience working with data-intensive applications, quantitative systems, or analytical platforms built with Python and/or similar languages (e.g. R, Matlab, Julia)
* Knowledge of financial markets, the investment management business, and associated research practices
* Experience partnering with researchers, analysts, product owners, or business stakeholders to gather requirements and implement technology solutions that support data-driven decision-making
* Strong background working with large, complex datasets and ing data science methodologies to extract meaning and value for business partners
* Expertise to create data visualizations that drive effective decision-making
* Familiarity with data models that enable efficient storage, integration, retrieval, and analysis of complex datasets
* Experience designing data quality frameworks and controls, including monitoring, validation, lineage tracking, governance processes, and observability
* Proven ability to collaborate effectively within Agile and DevOps environments, partnering with Product Owners, Architects, engineers, and governance teams to deliver high-quality solutions that meet enterprise standards for quality, reliability, and supportability

  

**Preffered Qualifications**

* Advanced degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, quantitative finance, or a related technical discipline
* Experience supporting quantitative investment research, model development, backtesting, portfolio analytics, performance attribution, or other investment management workflows
* Demonstrated ability to uncover complex patterns and insights through advanced analysis of large and diverse datasets
* Experience developing data visualization, self-service analytics, and researcher-facing tooling that transforms data into actionable insights and improves decision-making
* Experience evaluating and ing emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence, machine learning, generative AI, or advanced analytics techniques, to improve platform capabilities and researcher productivity
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, including experience presenting technical concepts, architectural proposals, and analytical findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Track record of championing innovation, experimentation, and continuous improvement through the adoption of new technologies, engineering practices, or operating models

  
  

**What’s in it for you**
------------------------

At Schwab India, you’re empowered to shape your future. We support your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture rooted in trust and collaboration – so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. Our benefits are designed to care for your wellbeing, your family, and your long-term financial security.

**Our base benefits, wellbeing, and total rewards include:**
------------------------------------------------------------

* Competitive compensation and retirement programs including Employee Provident Fund (EPF), Gratuity, and optional National Pension System (NPS) contributions
* Robust Paid Time Off, including annual/privilege leave, sick and casual leave, public holidays, maternity/paternity leave, and more
* Comprehensive medical insurance with Outpatient Department (OPD) services, including vaccination, pharmacy, dental, and vision coverage
* Annual reimbursement for health check-ups and mental health support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Childcare (creche) reimbursement for eligible employees
* Transportation and meal benefits that support your day-to-day work
* Group life, personal accident, and critical illness insurance

Role Purpose
  
The Client Delivery Manager (CDM) is accountable for day-to-day service delivery, operational governance, SLA/KPI performance, cost efficiency, resource management and continual service improvement across assigned Cloud, Infrastructure and Cybersecurity engagements.
  
  
Reporting into the Client Delivery Executive (CDE), the CDM converts contractual and client commitments into disciplined daily, weekly and monthly execution. Service Operations Delivery Control
  

* Own daily operations across relevant service towers and ensure delivery meets SLAs, KPIs, SLOs, contractual commitments and operating procedures.
* Run daily, weekly and monthly operating rhythms, including service reviews, delivery dashboards, action tracking and closure governance.
* Maintain operational stability, service quality and business continuity across global, multi-vendor and multi-tower environments.

Incident, Problem, Change Risk Management
  

* Lead operational response for major incidents, outages, missed SLAs and service escalations; ensure timely communication, restoration and follow-through.

Resource, Vendor Asset Management
  

* Manage workforce demand, staffing, shifts, skills, utilization, onboarding/offboarding, knowledge transfer and succession coverage.

* Identify repetitive work, ticket drivers and process gaps suitable for automation, AIOps and intelligent service management.
* Partner with the Principal Client Architect and practices to implement approved improvements and embed them into standard operations.
* Measure realized outcomes such as ticket reduction, faster restoration, reduced manual effort, improved reliability and better user experience.

* Coach delivery and operations leaders, set clear expectations and build a culture of accountability, ITIL discipline, collaboration and customer focus.
* Develop operational capability, certifications, cross-skilling, engagement and retention across geographically distributed teams.

Required Experience Qualifications
  

* 14+ years in IT services or managed services, including substantial responsibility for enterprise infrastructure, cloud or cybersecurity operations.
* Proven leadership of day-to-day service delivery across complex, global and multi-tower accounts with measurable SLA/KPI and customer outcomes.
* Strong experience in major incident, problem, change, risk, transition, service improvement and operational governance.

At Charles Schwab, our purpose is simple: we champion client’s goals with passion and integrity. Our people are the foundation of our success – they approach their work with curiosity and collaboration, coming together to create solutions that make a meaningful impact for clients and communities. Our Hyderabad location is central to Schwab’s growth, bringing together talented people and technology to drive innovation, scale and efficiency. The Cyber Assessments and Resilience Team is a first line of defense team positioned within the Schwab Cybersecurity Services vertical, aligned to ensure that services and applications within the Schwab Portfolio are assessed from a technology risk, cybersecurity risk, and cyber resilience perspective.

The cybersecurity risk assessor is a subject matter expert (SME) who works as part of the team to assess cybersecurity risks against established requirements, standards, policies and frameworks. The individual is responsible for proactive identification, assessment, treatment, and continuous monitoring of information security and technology risks. As a risk assessment SME, the individual reviews cybersecurity practices and recommends remediation of gaps or proposes new controls, consistent with best practices, as well as continually evaluates risk exposure and tolerance as defined by business leaders and external entities. The role also reviews and documents deficiencies, advocates for change and, when appropriate, escalates issues to senior risk leadership.

This is a key role in assuring that cyber risks are effectively managed, Schwab client information is protected, and our client’s trust is maintained. Success in this role will require ability to exercise influence, communicate effectively, think strategically, and work collaboratively among internal and external stakeholders across multiple functions combined with strong expertise in risk management discipline and security and technology controls best practices. This is an individual contributor role.

**What you have**
-----------------

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Receive and triage new assessment requests relating to on-prem, public cloud, third party, acquired applications, processes, and standards. Review inherent risk characteristics and validate the inherent risk is accurate to prepare for assessment.
* Partner with a distributed team consisting of security architects, engineers, and risk practitioners to determine the assessment scope and rigor based on inherent risk
* Maintain coordination and organization of assessments in flight between all key security teams involved throughout the lifecycle of the assessment.
* Translate control gaps identified from security architecture and engineering teams into security conditions and documented issues in a risk-based language that can be shared with application and system owners for remediation.
* Coordinate with application and technology teams and explain gaps which need actioning prior to production release, while communicating risks identified by assessment up to senior management.
* Document effectiveness of the application/system, process, or third party and the residual risk resulting from the assessment.
* Prepare a detailed cybersecurity risk assessment report based on existing risk reporting models and templates.
* Perform continuous monitoring and tracking of identified gaps and provide regular risk updates to senior management
* Create and present risk posture discovery and recommendation reports to risk management leadership.
* Develop and deliver executive-level reporting and presentations outlining cyber risks, risk velocity/trending, and status of defined action plans.
* Identify and manage continuous improvements in various areas, including automation of risk assessments, leadership reporting activities, development and maintenance of risk-related information, and audit and/or regulatory areas.
* Contribute to the creation and ongoing development of security and control metrics.
* Support maturing cyber risk governance through development of standard processes and procedures.
* Advocate and promote awareness of cyber risks to business and technical partners.

Other responsibilities include:

* Build strong relationships and partner closely with security and technology partners across Charles Schwab Corporation and its affiliates.
* Develop internal processes to increase team efficiencies and continually mature operations.
* Other risk related responsibilities as identified
* May travel minimally as needed

**Required Experience**

* 3-5 years of relevant experience in the disciplines of information security, risk assessment activities or information security compliance with strong hands-on experience in security risk assessments.
* Superior attention to detail and focus on quality work delivery

Job Description: Innovation Lead

Role Overview

Seeking a visionary and hands-on Innovation Lead to drive the design, prototyping, and delivery of next-generation solutions across the organization. This leader will identify emerging technologies—particularly in Artificial Intelligence / Generative AI, cloud (AWS), and data platforms—and translate them into production-grade capabilities built on a strong .NET/Java engineering foundation. Key Responsibilities

AI & Emerging Technology Innovation

* Design and implement AI-powered features such as intelligent assistants, document/data extraction, recommendation systems, forecasting, and anomaly detection.
* Establish frameworks for LLM integration, prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, vector search, fine-tuning, and model evaluation.

Cloud Solution Architecture (AWS)

* Architect scalable, secure, and cost-optimized solutions on AWS.

  + Compute: Lambda, ECS/EKS, EC2

* Build ephemeral and self-service environments to accelerate prototyping and experimentation.
* Optimize cloud utilization, performance, and cost.

Data & Database Engineering

* Design and optimize relational and NoSQL databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle, DynamoDB, MongoDB).
* Architect data pipelines, ETL/ELT flows, and data models supporting analytics and AI workloads.
* Implement vector databases (pgvector, OpenSearch, Pinecone) to support semantic search and RAG.
* Ensure data quality, governance, lineage, security, and compliance.
* Enable data-driven decision-making through dashboards, analytics, and reporting.

Application Engineering (.NET / Java)

* Lead the design and development of enterprise-grade applications and microservices using .NET (C#) and/or Java (Spring Boot).
* Define architecture standards, coding best practices, API design (REST/GraphQL/gRPC), and design patterns.
* Build robust, secure, high-performance backend services and integration layers.
* Modernize legacy applications and migrate workloads to cloud-native architectures.

Automation & Engineering Excellence

* Embed intelligent automation across the full software delivery lifecycle.
* Design and build automated frameworks for:
  + CI/CD and deployment automation
  + Testing (UI, API, end-to-end) using Playwright
  + Infrastructure provisioning and teardown
  + Data generation and environment setup
* Create configurable mock services, simulators, and stubs for third-party dependencies to enable independent development and testing (success/failure scenarios, timeouts, latency, rate limiting, auth failures, edge cases).
* Integrate automation and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins).
* Enable parallel execution, self-service capabilities, and reusable platforms for engineering teams.

DevOps & Observability

* Champion DevOps culture—containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), automation, and continuous delivery.
* Implement monitoring, logging, tracing, and diagnostics for applications and infrastructure.
* Drive reliability, scalability, security, and execution speed across platforms.

Leadership & Collaboration

* Mentor and technically lead cross-functional engineering teams.
* Partner with product, business, and leadership stakeholders to align innovation with strategic goals.
* Communicate complex technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Evangelize best practices, reusable assets, and a culture of continuous learning.

Required Skills

AI & Machine Learning

* Hands-on experience with Generative AI / LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI).
* Experience with RAG, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector databases, and model evaluation.
* Familiarity with ML frameworks and MLOps concepts.
* Understanding of Responsible AI, governance, and security.

Programming & Application Development

* Strong hands-on expertise in .NET (C#) and/or Java (Spring Boot).
* Experience designing microservices, APIs, and distributed systems.
* Working knowledge of Python and TypeScript/JavaScript is a strong plus.

AWS & Cloud Infrastructure

* IAM, Lambda, ECS/EKS, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, RDS/Aurora, Step Functions, EventBridge, CloudWatch.
* AI/ML services: Bedrock, SageMaker, Textract, Comprehend.
* Infrastructure as Code: Terraform (preferred), AWS CDK, CloudFormation.

Databases & Data

* Strong SQL and NoSQL database design and optimization.
* Data modeling, ETL/ELT pipelines, and data governance.
* Vector/semantic search technologies.

Automation & DevOps

* Playwright for UI, API, and end-to-end automation; cross-browser testing (Chrome, Edge, Firefox).
* Service virtualization & mocking: WireMock, MockServer, Hoverfly, Mountebank, Pact.
* Containerization: Docker, Kubernetes.
* CI/CD: GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins.
* Test data generation and management

Ideal Candidate Profile

* 12+ years of experience in software engineering, solution architecture, platform engineering, or innovation/R&D roles.
* Proven track record of taking AI and emerging-technology ideas from concept to production at scale.
* Strong AWS automation and Infrastructure-as-Code expertise.
* Deep hands-on .NET and/or Java development background with strong database engineering skills.
* Demonstrated experience building automation frameworks, mock services, and self-service platforms.
* Strong understanding of microservices, APIs, distributed systems, cloud-native design, and CI/CD practices.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
* A builder's mindset—curious, pragmatic, and biased toward rapid experimentation and delivery.

title: Embedded Linux and BSP Engineer
description:
Hyderabad, Telangana, India

Job Type

Full Time

Workspace

Hyderabad, India

**About the Role**
------------------

About the Role  
We are looking for a hands-on Embedded Linux engineer to build lean, secure, field-updatable Linux images for ARM-based edge computers, including SoC-plus-FPGA and industrial boards. You will own the path from bootloader to root filesystem, so that images are small, survive power loss, update safely and rebuild reproducibly, even without internet access.  
  
You will work directly with the Principal Architect on long-lifecycle, high-reliability products where memory is tight and every dependency must justify itself.

  

**Requirements**
----------------

### **Key Responsibilities**

#### **Platform and Image Engineering**

* Own **Yocto/OpenEmbedded layers** (distro, machine and image recipes) and the build flow (kas or repo).
* Produce **minimal images** (musl/BusyBox or systemd) within strict size, RAM and boot-time budgets, along with a developer SDK.
* Run **offline, reproducible builds** with source and sstate mirrors, vendored dependencies and pinned versions.
* Generate **SBOMs and licence reports**, and enforce licence policy at build time.
* Evaluate OpenWrt or Buildroot where they are the better fit.

#### **Bootloader, Kernel and Drivers**

* Customise **U-Boot** (SPL, FIT images, environment, A/B slot logic) and the **Linux kernel** (minimal configuration, device tree and overlays).
* Write and debug drivers for SPI, UART, I2C, USB, Ethernet, watchdog, RTC, GPIO and pin control.
* Bring up **SoC-plus-FPGA platforms**: programmable-logic device trees, and real-time cores with remoteproc and OpenAMP.
* Tune latency and real-time behaviour, including PREEMPT\_RT where needed.

#### **Update, Security and Resilience**

* Implement **A/B updates with automatic rollback** (RAUC, SWUpdate or Mender) and a **read-only root with overlay**.
* Build a **secure boot chain**: signed images, dm-verity, key handling, and TPM or TrustZone/OP-TEE integration.
* Design **power-fail-safe storage** (ext4, F2FS, UBIFS, SQLite durability) and watchdog and health strategies.
* Design for bit errors and wear: error-correction awareness, integrity checks and recovery.

#### **Quality, Performance and CI**

* Profile boot time and memory (perf, ftrace, bootchart, smem) and add **image-size regression checks**.
* Build CI for images with QEMU and hardware-in-the-loop tests, and write clear runbooks.

### **Required Qualifications**

#### **Education:**

* BE/B.Tech/M.Tech in Electronics, Embedded Systems, Computer Science or a related field.

#### **Experience:**

* **4–5+ years** in embedded Linux, with at least one product shipped on a Yocto-based or similar custom image.
* Hands-on bootloader and kernel work on ARM platforms.

### **Technical Skills Required**

#### **Yocto and Build Systems**

* Layers, bbappend, devtool, SDK generation, sstate and download mirrors, SPDX and licence controls.

#### **Bootloaders and Kernel**

* U-Boot, FIT images and secure boot, device tree, kernel configuration and debugging.

#### **Storage, Update and Security**

* squashfs and overlayfs, dm-verity, RAUC/SWUpdate/Mender, hardened userland.

#### **Hardware and Debug**

* JTAG/SWD, serial consoles, logic analyser, oscilloscope, crash-dump analysis.

#### **Languages and Tooling**

* Strong C, shell and Python; Git and CI; cross-compilation for aarch64 and armv7.

### **Preferred (Bonus) Skills**

* Zynq-class SoC-plus-FPGA work with vendor tooling.
* High-reliability design experience (fault containment, integrity checks, error correction).
* Rust, and familiarity with open-source licences (MIT, Apache, GPL, AGPL).

### **Why Join Us**

At **EURTH TECHTRONICS PVT LTD**, we design and deliver connected electronics from idea to deployment. Build the foundation that real devices boot from. You will work on long-lifecycle products where size, security and recoverability matter, with direct access to a senior architect and real hardware.

About the Role  
We are looking for a firmware engineer who understands radios as well as code. You will build firmware for long-range, low-power wireless devices and test tools, from radio drivers and protocol stacks to key storage, over-the-air updates and field validation. You will think in link budgets, timing and security, not just in registers.  
  
You will work directly with the Principal Architect on connected products where reliability in the field, power efficiency and security matter as much as features.

  

**Requirements**
----------------

### **Key Responsibilities**

#### **Radio and Protocol Firmware**

* Develop and maintain **LoRa and LoRaWAN** protocol stacks (1.0.x and 1.1): activation, device classes, receive windows, MAC commands, adaptive data rate and regional parameters.
* Apply **spread-spectrum and frequency-hopping radio concepts**, and bring up new radio chipsets and modes behind a clean driver interface.
* Implement robust **retry, acknowledgement and duplicate-handling strategies** for lossy and high-latency links.

#### **Link and RF Engineering**

* Perform **link-budget analysis** and interpret sensitivity, interference and range-test data.
* Account for **frequency stability and timing** (crystal and TCXO choice, drift, offset handling) in radio design and firmware.
* Run **field range and reliability trials**, and turn the results into firmware and configuration improvements.

#### **Security and Key Management**

* Implement AES-128 and AES-CMAC correctly, and manage keys in **protected storage or a secure element**.
* Design **secure device activation and key lifecycle**: provisioning, rotation, revocation, and safe persistence of counters across resets.
* Build **signed over-the-air updates** with a secure boot chain.

#### **Drivers, Gateways and Test**

* Write **SPI radio drivers** and work with gateway-side software (concentrator HALs, packet forwarders and bridges) and timing sources.
* Build **test infrastructure**: Python simulators, hardware-in-the-loop automation, power profiling and instrument-based RF validation.

* AES-CMAC and AES-CTR, key storage, secure boot, safe counter handling.

#### **Instruments and Tools**

* Spectrum analyser, power profiler, protocol sniffers, logic analyser, JTAG/SWD.

* Python, Git and CI.

* SDR capture and analysis (IQ recordings, GNU Radio) and DSP fundamentals.

title: Architect I - Cloud Infrastructure Services
description:
**Role description**

Cloud Architect, Codon Platform (AWS and Azure)

Location: UST Hyderabad

Type: Full time, in-house

About the role

Codon is UST's governed developer platform: a web chat and a browser terminal that put Claude to work on ServiceNow and other enterprise platforms, with every write

audited, every secret brokered, and every destination controlled at the network edge. It runs today on AWS (ECS Fargate, RDS PostgreSQL, EFS, internal ALB with blue/green

deployments, a Squid egress tier) with Azure for identity (Entra) and Key Vault, reached over a transit gateway, SD-WAN and Zscaler.

We are hiring the person who owns this architecture end to end and takes it from a single-tenant dev and pilot footprint to a secure, multi-tenant, resilient product. You

will be the technical authority for infrastructure, the counterpart to our network, security, identity and AI gateway teams, and the hands that write the Terraform.

What you will do

Architecture and roadmap

* + Own the target architecture for Codon across AWS and Azure: landing zone, account and subscription structure, network, identity, data, secrets, observability.

* + Design and deliver multi-tenancy: tenant isolation at the account, network, data and identity layers; per-tenant cost attribution; tenant onboarding as code.

* + Design and deliver disaster recovery and business continuity: RPO and RTO targets per tier, cross-region strategy, backup and restore drills, runbooks that are

rehearsed, not written once.

* + Define the environment model (dev, test, pilot, production) and the promotion path between them, including the deployment gate that holds a release until its checks

Security

* + Raise the platform to a documented security posture: least-privilege IAM, workload identity, secret rotation with zero downtime (we already rotate database and gateway

keys), private endpoints, egress allow-listing, encryption and key management (KMS and Key Vault).

* + Run threat modelling for the platform's trust boundaries, including an AI agent with a shell inside a container, and close the findings.

* + Prepare the platform for internal security review and for customer audits (SOC 2 style evidence, logging and retention, access reviews).

Build and operate

* + Write and review the Terraform (modules, environment roots, policy as code). Everything is code; nothing is clicked in a console.

* + Own the CI/CD and release tooling with the product team: image builds, SBOMs, the deployer, evidence capture.

* + Set up observability that answers questions in minutes: central logging, metrics, tracing, ing, cost dashboards.

* + Lead incident analysis across teams. Recent examples from our own log: a rotated database password that silently broke new connections, an egress path that drops for

hours on a shared security gateway, a load balancer whose private addresses changed under a fixed route.

Work with others

* + Be the single technical contact for UST's Network, Cloud, Security, Identity and AI gateway teams; turn their constraints into designs and their requests into tickets

with evidence.

* + Pair with the product engineers daily. Review their infrastructure changes, teach them the platform's rules, and keep the design records current.

* + Guide one or two platform engineers as the team grows.

What you bring

Experience

* + 12 to 14 years in software or infrastructure engineering, of which at least 10 years hands-on in public cloud, with production ownership on both AWS and Azure. Depth on

one, real delivery on the other.

* + You have designed and operated at least one multi-tenant SaaS platform and at least one cross-region DR setup, and you can describe what broke in each.

* + You have written Terraform for years, not months. You can read a plan and tell what will be replaced and why.

Technical

* + AWS: VPC design, Transit Gateway, PrivateLink, ECS or EKS, RDS, EFS, ALB and NLB, IAM, KMS, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch, Route 53, Organizations and SCPs.

* + Azure: Entra ID (enterprise apps, SAML and OIDC, conditional access), Key Vault with private endpoints, VNets and Private Link, Azure Policy, hybrid connectivity.

* + Networking: routing across cloud and on-premises, SD-WAN and security gateways such as Zscaler, TLS and certificate lifecycle, DNS split-horizon.

* + Security: zero trust principles, workload identity, secret rotation, container hardening, audit logging, compliance evidence.

* + Containers and delivery: Docker, Fargate or Kubernetes, blue/green and canary deployments, GitHub Actions or equivalent, SBOM and vulnerability management.

* + Comfortable reading application code (TypeScript or Python) well enough to find where an infrastructure assumption lives.

Ways of working

* + You write things down: decision records, runbooks, incident reports with evidence. You prefer a diagram and a table to a meeting.

* + You test in production-like conditions and rehearse failures before they happen.

* + You are direct with other teams about what is theirs and what is ours, with the logs to show it.

Certifications (any two, or equivalent demonstrated experience)

* + AWS Solutions Architect Professional or DevOps Engineer Professional

* + Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305)

* + A security credential such as AWS Security Specialty, AZ-500 or CCSP

Nice to have

* + Experience hosting LLM or agent workloads: gateways, key brokering, cost metering per user, isolation of agent sandboxes.

* + Enterprise platform background: ServiceNow, Salesforce or SAP integration patterns.

* + FinOps practice: cost allocation by tenant, rightsizing, commitment planning.

* + Exposure to regulated environments and customer audits.

First six months, what success looks like

* A written target architecture for multi-tenant Codon on AWS and Azure, reviewed with Security and Network, with a sequenced plan.

2.Production environment stood up as code with the deployment gate, logging, ing and cost reporting in place.

3.A DR design with targets agreed, and the first restore drill completed and documented.

4.The current security findings closed, secret rotation proven without downtime, and an audit evidence pack that a reviewer can read.

5.Standing working agreements with the Network, Identity and AI gateway teams, with named contacts and response expectations.

  
**Skills**

AWS, Azure Policy, AWS Transit Gateway, AWS Fargate

Powered by technology, inspired by people and led by purpose, UST partners with their clients from design to operation. With deep domain expertise and a future-proof philosophy, UST embeds innovation and agility into their clients’ organizations. With over 30,000 employees in 30 countries, UST builds for boundless impact—touching billions of lives in the process.
