Opella is the self-care challenger with the purest and third-largest portfolio in the Over-The-Counter (OTC) & Vitamins, Minerals & Supplements (VMS) market globally.

Our mission is to bring health in people’s hands by making self-care as simple as it should be. For half a billion consumers worldwide – and counting.

At the core of this mission is our 100 loved brands, our 11,000-strong global team, our 13 best-in-class manufacturing sites and 4 specialized science and innovation development centers. Headquartered in France, Opella is the proud maker of many of the world’s most loved brands, including Allegra, Buscopan, Doliprane, Dulcolax, Enterogermina, Essentiale and Mucosolvan.

B Corp certified in multiple markets, we are active players in the journey towards healthier people and planet. Find out more about our mission at www.opella.com.

  

**About the Role:**

As an AI Solutions Expert/Specialist, you will own the design, development, and deployment of artificial intelligence solutions that automate and optimize the end-to-end content lifecycle across a global CPG organization. You will work at the intersection of AI engineering and content operations — connecting proofs of concept, MVPs, and enterprise-grade platforms to streamline how content is generated, organized, and delivered across every consumer and professional touchpoint.

This includes finance, commercial, advertising, social media, e-commerce, email marketing, HCP communications, packaging, point-of-sale materials, in-store activations, and regulatory submissions.

* Architect and lead AI-driven solutions that automate content creation, adaptation, review, approval, and distribution across all content channels and markets

* Build and maintain production-grade applications on Microsoft Azure, leveraging Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, Document Intelligence, Azure OpenAI Service, Azure Cognitive Services, and related platform services

* Integrate large language models, image generation models, video models, and multi-modal AI systems into scalable content workflows

* Design and implement data pipelines that connect AI models to enterprise content repositories, PIM systems, DAM platforms, and downstream delivery channels

* Drive initiatives through the full lifecycle — from POC through MVP to enterprise-scale deployment — establishing engineering standards, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and governance at each stage

* Collaborate cross-functionally with brand marketing, e-commerce, regulatory/legal, medical affairs, creative agencies, and IT to translate business needs into technical solutions

* Evaluate and integrate emerging AI technologies, foundation models, and Azure services to continuously advance the content ecosystem

* Define governance standards for AI model usage, data quality, content compliance, brand safety, and responsible AI practices

* Mentor developers and engineers on AI/ML engineering patterns, cloud-native development, and Azure best practices

  

**General Business**

**Required Qualifications:**

* 8+ years of experience in software/application development, with a significant portion focused on AI/ML solution engineering

* Hands-on expertise with Azure AI Foundry, Azure Document Intelligence, Azure AI Search, Azure OpenAI Service, and Azure Cognitive/AI Services

* Strong application development background — ability to build, ship, and maintain production-grade software, not just prototypes or notebooks

* Proven experience with LLMs including prompt engineering, fine-tuning, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and agentic architectures

* Experience with generative AI for image, video, and/or multi-modal content creation

* Solid experience designing and operating data pipelines in Azure (Azure Data Factory, Azure Functions, Event Grid, or equivalent)

* Proficiency in Python and at least one additional enterprise language (C#, TypeScript, Java)

* Strong understanding of API design, microservices architecture, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes/AKS), and cloud-native patterns

* Experience deploying AI solutions through the full maturity curve: POC MVP enterprise production

* Hands-on experience with DevOps and MLOps tooling — Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, MLflow, model versioning, drift monitoring, automated retraining, and A/B testing in production

* Working knowledge of database technologies including Cosmos DB, Azure SQL, and data lake architectures (Azure Data Lake, Blob Storage, Azure Synapse)

* Experience building with AI orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or AutoGen

* Familiarity with front-end and full-stack patterns (React or Angular, FastAPI/Flask backends, serverless architectures) to deliver end-to-end solutions.

**Required Technical Skills:**

**Cloud & AI Platform**

Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI Service, Azure Cognitive Services, Azure Machine Learning, Azure AI Search, Azure Document Intelligence, Azure Bot Service

Data Engineering

Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse, Azure Event Hub / Event Grid, Azure Functions, Cosmos DB, Azure SQL, Blob Storage, Data Lake

**AI/ML Frameworks**

LangChain, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, Hugging Face, PyTorch, TensorFlow, ONNX

**Generative AI**

Deep Agents, Agentic Workflow developments, multi-modal pipelines

DevOps & MLOps

Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Docker, Kubernetes / AKS, MLflow, Weights & Biases, model registry, CI/CD for ML

**App Development**

REST / GraphQL APIs, React or Angular, FastAPI / Flask, microservices, serverless, event-driven architectures

**Security & Governance**

Azure RBAC, Key Vault, Managed Identity, responsible AI tooling, content safety APIs

**General Business**

Languages: Python, TypeScript / JavaScript, SQL

Good to Have — Domain & Business Experience.

* Experience working in or with CPG, FMCG, consumer health, or pharmaceutical organizations

* Familiarity with consumer advertising and media production workflows (TV, digital, social, programmatic)

* Exposure to social media content operations, scheduling platforms, and performance analytics

* Understanding of e-commerce product content (product descriptions, A+ content, marketplace listings)

* Awareness of email marketing and CRM-driven personalization tools (Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Adobe Campaign, or similar)

* Experience with HCP and medical affairs communications in regulated environments

* Knowledge of packaging artwork, labeling workflows, and regulatory/legal review cycles

* Familiarity with point-of-sale and in-store activation material production

* Experience with PIM and DAM platforms (Salsify, Akeneo, Adobe AEM, Bynder, or similar)

* Understanding of regulatory submission, claims substantiation, and content compliance frameworks (FDA, EU MDR, local market regulations)

* Exposure to localization and transcreation processes across global markets

* Experience integrating with enterprise platforms such as SAP, Veeva, Salesforce, or Others

* Azure certifications (AI Engineer Associate, Solutions Architect Expert, or equivalent)

* Track record of working in AI Centers of Excellence or capability-building functions

* Experience managing vendor and agency relationships for AI tooling and creative technology

What You’ll Impact.

* Speed and cost-efficiency of content production across global markets

* Brand consistency and regulatory compliance across all consumer and professional touchpoints

* Data-driven decision-making through AI-powered content insights and performance analytics

* AI agentic automation and process efficiency gains

**Why us?**  
  
At Opella, you will enjoy doing challenging, purposeful work, empowered to develop consumer brands with passion and creativity. This is your chance to grow new skills and be part of a bold, collaborative, and inclusive culture where people can thrive and be at their best every day.

This is a unique opportunity to be part of our early growth phase and shape something new, backed by the stability and strength of a Fortune 500 company. Your impact begins on day one, and your contributions will help define our future in the region.

**What you have**
-----------------

  
  

**Role Description**

Join an opportunity to lead the design and delivery of enterprise-scale data, analytics, visualization, and workflow automation solutions that directly improve business decision-making. You will shape modern BI solutions across Power BI, Tableau, Power Apps, and Power Automate while establishing scalable engineering patterns supported by strong SQL, data modeling, and semantic-layer expertise.
  
  
This highly visible role provides the opportunity to influence technical direction, modernize legacy reporting, and help expand trusted self-service analytics across the organization. You will collaborate with business leaders, product owners, data engineers, architects, risk partners, and platform teams to turn complex or ambiguous needs into secure, maintainable solutions.
  
  
As a senior technical leader, you will mentor developers, promote engineering excellence, and help define the next generation of enterprise BI and Power Platform capabilities.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Power Platform solutions using Power BI, Tableau, Power Apps, Power Automate, and advanced SQL.
* Lead technical discovery with business and technology partners, translating ambiguous objectives into actionable solution designs, delivery roadmaps, and measurable business outcomes.
* Own the end-to-end technical delivery of high-visibility analytics products, including data analysis, SQL development, semantic models, dashboards, applications, automated workflows, testing, deployment, and production support.
* Establish reusable development standards, reference architectures, design patterns, source-control practices, release processes, and quality controls for BI and Power Platform development.
* Drive modernization and rationalization initiatives, including Tableau-to-Power BI migration, report consolidation, process automation, technical-debt reduction, and retirement of redundant analytics assets.
* Architect governed Power BI semantic models and reusable Tableau data assets that promote consistent metrics, trusted business definitions, scalability, and self-service analytics.
* Analyze complex data structures, embedded business logic, source-system dependencies, and SQL queries to identify data-quality, performance, reconciliation, and migration risks.
* Ensure solutions adhere to applicable security, privacy, accessibility, data-governance, change-management, and operational-support requirements.
    
  Partner with platform administrators, data engineers, application teams, and architects to integrate enterprise data sources, APIs, gateways, connectors, and cloud services.
* Manage technical operations and delivery risks by monitoring solution performance, prioritizing remediation, coordinating production support, and communicating status to leadership.
* Mentor and coach BI engineers and developers through solution reviews, design sessions, code reviews, technical training, and hands-on problem resolution.
* Influence the BI and automation roadmap by evaluating emerging capabilities, recommending investments, and presenting strategic options to senior stakeholders.

**Required Qualifications**

* 7-10+ years of progressive BI solutions development and technical leadership across Tableau, Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate, and advanced SQL.
* Proven ability to architect enterprise-scale, governed Power BI semantic models and reusable Tableau data assets.
* Advanced SQL mastery, including performance tuning and troubleshooting across large, multi-source enterprise environments.
* Demonstrated experience owning end-to-end technical delivery of high-visibility analytics products and workflow-automation solutions.
* Experience establishing enterprise development standards, reference architectures, and quality controls for BI/Power Platform.
* Track record leading modernization and rationalization initiatives (e.g., Tableau-to-Power BI migration, report consolidation).
* Experience mentoring and providing technical leadership to BI engineers and developers.
* Bachelor's degree required, Master's preferred, with proven senior technical leadership in enterprise BI environments.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience leading multi-year, enterprise-scale BI platform migrations (Tableau to Power BI), including vendor/accelerator evaluation.
* Deep expertise with Microsoft Fabric, Power BI Premium capacity planning, and DataOps/CI-CD practices.
* Experience building and governing enterprise Power Platform Center of Excellence frameworks (DLP, environments, ALM).
* Executive-level communication experience, including presenting BI/AI strategy and roadmaps to senior leadership.
* Experience with AI-assisted BI development (e.g., Copilot-assisted report/DAX conversion, agentic BI workflows).
* Relevant advanced certification(s) such as Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Solution Architect or Fabric Analytics Engineer.
* Experience managing vendor/consulting partnerships for BI modernization delivery.
* Experience designing BI operating models, RACI structures, or federated BI governance frameworks.
  

  

**What’s in it for you**
------------------------

At Schwab India, you’re empowered to shape your future. We support your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture rooted in trust and collaboration – so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. Our benefits are designed to care for your wellbeing, your family, and your long-term financial security.

* Robust Paid Time Off, including annual/privilege leave, sick and casual leave, public holidays, maternity/paternity leave, and more

We are located in Austin (USA), Singapore, Hyderabad, Indore and Ahmedabad (India).

* Lead sprint planning and execution for the pod, making sure committed scope is delivered on time and meets the definition of done.
* Conduct code and design reviews across backend (Java/Spring Boot, Python), frontend (Angular) and integration components, enforcing quality, security and performance standards.
* Design scalable microservices, REST APIs and integration patterns, including connectors to SaaS, cloud, data and AI platforms.
* Drive release readiness: test coverage, CI/CD quality gates, documentation and deployment sign-off.
* Identify and manage technical risks, dependencies and blockers, and escalate early to the Engineering Manager.
* Collaborate with product managers, architects, UX designers and QA to translate requirements into technical solutions.

* Proven track record of leading agile teams that deliver enterprise SaaS products or platforms.
* Strong hands-on background in Java/Spring Boot and/or Python, with the ability to review full-stack code.

**Mandatory Skills:**

* Strong expertise in Java, Spring Boot and microservices architecture, with working knowledge of Python.
* Experience designing RESTful APIs, event-driven integrations and data models for distributed systems.
* Hands-on experience with AWS and/or Azure, Docker and Kubernetes.
* Working knowledge of Angular and TypeScript, enough to review frontend designs and code.

* Solid understanding of CI/CD pipelines, automated testing and release management.
* Experience with Agile/Scrum, backlog refinement and estimation, using tools such as Jira and Confluence.

***Company Overview***  
*AutoRABIT is an enterprise platform for Salesforce DevSecOps that enables organizations to manage AI-accelerated Salesforce development with greater security, governance, visibility, and control. Its integrated product suite supports the complete Salesforce DevSecOps lifecycle through* ***AutoRABIT ARM*** *for CI/CD and release management,* ***CodeScan*** *for static code analysis and application security,* ***Vault*** *for data backup and recovery, and* ***Guard*** *for security posture management. The platform helps enterprises automate deployments, improve code quality, protect critical Salesforce data, monitor access risks, and strengthen compliance.* ***AutoRABIT official website***  
  
*Purpose-built for complex enterprise Salesforce environments, AutoRABIT helps development teams increase productivity, accelerate delivery, and innovate without compromising security or reliability. Its metadata-aware capabilities, scalable platform, flexible hosting options, and integrations provide organizations with the structure and control required to manage Salesforce changes across teams, environments, and global operations. Headquartered in San Francisco, California, AutoRABIT serves customers worldwide and offers employees the opportunity to contribute to products at the intersection of Salesforce, DevSecOps, security, governance, and AI-enabled development.* ***AutoRABIT platform overview***  
  
***Job Role***  
*Provide technical leadership across AutoRABIT products and shared platform capabilities. Combine exceptional hands-on engineering with a strong view of customer needs, product differentiation and long-term technical direction. Your mandate is to improve the company’s ability to build products customers trust and choose, and to translate that direction into working software.*  
  
***Key Responsibilities***

* ***Company-level product direction.*** *Work with Product, the CTO, VP of Engineering and customer-facing leaders to identify the technical capabilities that matter most to customer value and product differentiation. Use customer evidence and market understanding to shape investment options, build-versus-buy decisions and long-term platform direction.*
* ***Cross-product architecture.*** *Guide architecture across product boundaries, shared services and integrations. Simplify dependencies, clarify interfaces and reduce systemic risks. Define staged modernisation plans that protect existing customers while enabling future capabilities. Establish decision principles with accountable product and engineering owners.*
* ***Hands-on execution.*** *Personally design and implement critical components, reference solutions and technically demanding capabilities. Lead complex initiatives through validation and rollout. Resolve the highest-impact systemic engineering problems without becoming the default owner of every difficult implementation task.*
* ***Production AI leadership.*** *Guide reliable AI-enabled capabilities and engineering practices. Establish evaluation methods, tenant and data boundaries, safe tool execution, oversight, observability and cost controls appropriate to each use case. Demonstrate where AI improves outcomes and where simpler approaches are preferable.*
* ***Engineering capability.*** *Mentor Principal Engineers, architects and senior technical leaders. Establish reusable practices for secure, reliable and maintainable delivery. Improve the quality of engineering decisions across teams and build leadership capacity that persists beyond your direct involvement.*
* ***Executive influence and accountability.*** *Communicate technical trade-offs in terms of customer impact, investment and risk. Partner with the CTO on enterprise direction and the VP of Engineering on execution. Agree decision rights for cross-product initiatives and make outcomes visible to leadership and the teams delivering them.*
* *Responsibility to adhere to set internal controls.*

***Pride of Ownership***  
*We value pride of ownership. Understand the customer, the product and the market need; form a clear, evidence-based opinion about how the product can improve; and work with others to turn that opinion into results. Strong coding skills and effective use of AI matter, but accountability continues after a feature is shipped. Be willing to challenge assumptions, listen to feedback and change your view when the evidence changes.*  
  
***Experience & Desired Skills***  
***Required Skills (Mandatory)***

* *15+ years delivering complex enterprise software, with sustained evidence of company-wide or multi-product technical impact.*
* *Exceptional hands-on expertise in Java, distributed systems, enterprise APIs and SaaS architecture.*
* *Experience leading major initiatives across multiple teams and bringing them into reliable production use.*
* *Demonstrated production AI delivery, including evaluation, security, operational performance and economic trade-offs.*
* *Deep understanding of cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure, modern delivery practices, containers, Kubernetes and Infrastructure as Code.*
* *Strong judgment in security, scalability, reliability, observability and architectural modernisation.*
* *Evidence of influencing product direction and translating technical investments into customer or business outcomes.*
* *Ability to mentor Principal-level engineers and influence executive decisions without relying on reporting authority.*

***Preferred Skills (Good to Have)***

* *Salesforce ecosystem products, DevSecOps, release orchestration, code analysis, security or data protection.*
* *Experience with regulated enterprise customers and globally distributed engineering teams.*
* *Major product achievements or other evidence of external-grade technical impact; patents, publications and open-source contributions are useful but not mandatory.*

***What success looks like***

* *Within 90 days, establish a shared view of the most important cross-product technical opportunities, risks and decision boundaries.*
* *Within six months, lead agreed milestones for a strategic platform initiative and demonstrate evidence of improved customer, engineering or business outcomes.*
* *Strengthen Principal-level technical leadership and establish a practical, prioritised investment agenda with Product and Engineering.*

***Why join AutoRABIT***  
*You will influence the future of AutoRABIT’s platform while remaining an active builder. The opportunity is to create lasting product advantage, simplify difficult engineering problems and grow the people who will deliver the next generation of capabilities.*  
  
***Experience:*** *15+ Years*  
***Compensation:*** *110 - 140 Lakhs per annum*  
***Location:*** *Hyderabad*

title: Tech Architect
description:
**Position Details**

* Department: Engineering / Technology
* Reports to: VP of Engineering / CTO
* Location: Hyderabad, India
* Work arrangement: In-office only
* Employment type: Full-time

**About the Role**

We are seeking a hands-on Tech Architect to define and drive the technical direction of our SaaS platform. You will architect and build scalable backend web services; design analytics pipelines for drone-captured images and videos; enable enterprise-grade single sign-on (SSO) and a secure, extensible integration layer; and turn proofs of concept (POCs) and prototypes into reliable, production-ready systems. You will also champion AI/LLM-powered agentic coding to improve engineering productivity, while setting high standards for security, quality, scalability, and operational readiness.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define end-to-end architecture for a multi-tenant SaaS platform, balancing scalability, performance, security, availability, and cost.
* Assess existing POC and prototype code, determine what can be reused versus re-architected, and define a practical path to production and go-live.
* Production-harden prototypes through robust error handling, logging, monitoring, automated testing, security controls, configuration management, and performance tuning.
* Own production-readiness reviews, load and performance testing, CI/CD and deployment strategies (including blue-green and canary releases), rollback plans, and post-launch support.
* Architect scalable analytics pipelines for drone-captured imagery and video, covering live-stream and bulk-field-upload ingestion, processing, model inference, storage, and API-based delivery of results.
* Address drone-data constraints, including large high-resolution media, intermittent or low-bandwidth connectivity, GPS and flight telemetry, altitude, gimbal/camera orientation, timestamps, and mapping data to missions, sites, and assets.
* Make architecture decisions for real-time versus batch processing, GPU/accelerator utilization, edge versus cloud inference, and cost optimization for media-heavy workloads.
* Architect enterprise identity and SSO using SAML 2.0, OIDC, and OAuth 2.0; support per-tenant SSO configuration, integrations with Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, and Google Workspace, SCIM provisioning, RBAC, and session management.
* Design and own the platform’s extensibility and integration layer, including public APIs, webhooks, SDKs, and plugin/extension models for customer, partner, third-party, drone-platform, and fleet-management integrations, with versioning, backward compatibility, and safe sandboxing.
* Own end-to-end security architecture, including API gateway and WAF controls, authentication and authorization, encryption in transit and at rest, secrets and key management, audit logging, and tenant data isolation.
* Drive secure-by-design practices through threat modelling, security reviews of designs and code, dependency and vulnerability management, and penetration-test remediation—including for AI-generated code and third-party extensions/integrations.
* Architect and oversee backend services, including REST/GraphQL APIs, microservices, and service-to-service communication.
* Remain hands-on: write and review production-grade backend code, build POCs, and demonstrate engineering standards by example.
* Design core SaaS capabilities such as multi-tenancy, subscription and billing integration, tenant data isolation, rate limiting, and horizontal scalability.
* Lead adoption of AI/LLM agentic coding tools such as Claude Code for delivery acceleration, refactoring, and productionizing prototype code.
* Establish workflows and best practices for AI-assisted software development, including code-review standards, guardrails, and quality gates for AI-generated code.

**Tech Architect | Job Description**

* Define technical standards, coding guidelines, and architectural patterns across engineering teams; evaluate and recommend technologies, frameworks, tools, and emerging AI/LLM and computer-vision capabilities.
* Partner with product managers and stakeholders to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions.
* Review and approve high-level designs (HLDs), guide low-level designs (LLDs), identify technical debt, and lead legacy-system modernization, using AI-assisted tools where beneficial.
* Ensure architecture meets non-functional requirements for scalability, availability, security, tenant isolation, and observability.
* Mentor senior engineers and tech leads on architecture, productionizing prototypes, and effective use of AI coding assistants.
* Lead POCs for new technologies, LLM/agentic workflows, vision models, and major system changes.
* Collaborate with DevOps/SRE teams on infrastructure, deployment, and CI/CD architecture.
* Own architecture documentation and keep it current across the organization.

**Required Qualifications & Technical Skills**

* 10–15 years of software engineering experience, including significant experience in architecture-focused roles.
* Proven experience building and scaling SaaS products end to end, ideally from early-stage development through growth.
* A demonstrated track record of taking POCs/prototypes to production through refactoring, re-architecture, hardening, and successful live launches with measurable reliability and performance.
* Strong backend engineering experience designing, building, and scaling production REST/GraphQL APIs and microservices.
* Experience designing or building systems that ingest and process drone-generated aerial imagery and video at scale, including use cases such as object detection, change detection, classification, tracking, and inspection.
* Understanding of video streaming protocols (RTSP, RTMP, WebRTC, HLS), encoding/transcoding, and large-scale media storage.
* Experience with drone data and metadata, including geo-tagged imagery, flight telemetry, geospatial context, and data flows from device or ground station to cloud.
* Familiarity with production deployment and serving of computer-vision/ML models, including inference optimization, GPU workloads, batching, and model versioning; exposure to OpenCV, FFmpeg, or similar frameworks.
* Hands-on experience implementing enterprise SSO and authentication using SAML, OIDC, OAuth2, and SCIM in multi-tenant SaaS products, including integration with major identity providers.
* Experience designing extensible platforms with public APIs, webhooks, SDKs, and plugin/extension or third-party integration frameworks, including versioning, rate limiting, and safe extension isolation.
* Strong security architecture skills covering API security, encryption, secrets management, tenant isolation, secure SDLC, threat modelling, and OWASP Top 10 risks and mitigations.
* Mandatory hands-on coding capability; this is an active engineering role, not solely an architecture-review position.
* Practical, demonstrable use of AI/LLM-based agentic coding tools (e.g., Claude Code) in real engineering workflows, beyond casual use.
* Strong expertise in system design, distributed systems, and microservices architecture.
* Experience with multi-tenant architecture, subscription billing systems, and SaaS scalability patterns.
* Hands-on experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP, including managed GPU/ML and media services.
* Deep proficiency in at least one major backend language/stack: Java, Python, Node.js, .NET, or Go.
* Deep understanding of SQL and NoSQL databases, data modelling, caching strategies (Redis or Memcached), and object storage.
* Strong experience with API design, API gateways, messaging/streaming systems such as Kafka or RabbitMQ, and service-integration patterns.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing strategies, and production observability, including logging, metrics, tracing, and alerting.
* Understanding of LLM fundamentals—prompting, context management, tool/function calling, RAG, agentic workflows, and multimodal models—sufficient to architect responsible AI integrations.

**Tech Architect | Job Description**

* Working knowledge of compliance and data-control frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, and GDPR, including privacy and data-retention considerations for aerial imagery and video. Regulated-industry experience is a plus, not mandatory.
* Excellent communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience leading architecture reviews and building consensus across engineering teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with drone SDKs/platforms such as DJI, MAVLink, PX4, or ArduPilot, or with drone fleet and mission-management software.
* Experience with geospatial and photogrammetry tooling, including GIS, orthomosaics, 3D reconstruction, GDAL, or PostGIS.
* Experience with edge/on-device inference or low-latency real-time video processing at a ground station or on a drone.
* Experience with video analytics platforms or stream-processing frameworks such as GStreamer, NVIDIA DeepStream, or Triton Inference Server.
* Experience building a developer ecosystem or marketplace, including partner APIs, app/extension marketplaces, and developer portals.
* Experience with zero-trust architecture, mutual TLS (mTLS), WAF/API-gateway policy design, or security tooling such as SAST/DAST and SIEM integrations.
* Experience with API monetization, usage-based billing, or SaaS metering systems.
* Experience building or integrating LLM-powered applications or agents in production.
* Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or similar agent-tooling frameworks.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or other containerization and orchestration technologies.
* Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC), including Terraform or CloudFormation.
* Experience with SRE practices, including SLOs/SLAs, incident response, and capacity planning.
* Prior experience scaling SaaS systems from startup to enterprise scale.
* Relevant certifications, such as AWS/Azure/GCP Solutions Architect, TOGAF, or security certifications.

**Role Expectations**

* Be a hands-on technical leader who can move fluidly between architecture, implementation, code review, production readiness, and technical mentoring.
* Balance rapid delivery with long-term maintainability, security, reliability, and cost efficiency.
* Build consensus across teams and communicate trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Application note: Candidates should be prepared to demonstrate hands-on backend engineering, productionizing POCs, SaaS architecture, drone-media/data pipeline design, enterprise SSO and security architecture, and practical use of AI-assisted coding tools.

Pay: ₹1,500,000.00 - ₹2,500,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

15. Work closely with Agile teams to deliver high-quality cloud solutions following DevOps and continuous integration practices.
  
  
Professional & Technical Skills:
  
1. 10 12+ years of hands-on experience designing and implementing AWS cloud integration solutions.
  
2. Strong expertise in AWS Glue for ETL development, data transformation, workflow orchestration, and enterprise data integration.
  
3. Extensive experience with AWS services including AWS Glue, AWS Lambda, AWS Step Functions, Amazon EventBridge, Amazon S3, Amazon DynamoDB, Amazon Athena, Amazon SQS, and AWS CodeBuild.

description:
Job Description
  
  
Senior. Specialist, Software Engineering (MuleSoft Integration)
  
The Opportunity
  
  

* Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.
* Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.
* Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the worlds greatest health threats.

Our Technology Centres focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our companys’ IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
  
A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centres.
  
  
Role Overview
  
The Senior Specialist, Software Engineering (MuleSoft Integration) is responsible for designing, developing, and supporting enterprise integration solutions that enable seamless connectivity across Animal Healths digital ecosystem. This role develops and maintains integrations on the MuleSoft AnyPpoint Platform, supporting strategic programs including OneCRM, Master Data Management, eCommerce, Customer Engagement, and other global initiatives across the enterprise.
  
Working closely with architects, product teams, and business stakeholders, the successful candidate will deliver scalable, secure, and reusable integration services that support the organizations API-first and platform engineering strategy. The role contributes to the System Integration foundational capabilty, one of the core platformdomains within AH IT Foundational Platforms Engineering.
  
  
What will you do in this role
  
  

* Design, develop, test, and deploy MuleSoft integrations and APIs.
* Implement API-led connectivity solutions using MuleSoft CloudHub 2.0 and Anypoint Runtime Fabric (RTF).
* Integrate Salesforce, SAP, MDM, data platforms, and enterprise applications.
* Create technical designs, API specifications, and supporting documentation.
* Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize integration performance.
* Ensure compliance with architecture, security, and DevSecOps standards.
* Support production operations, incident resolution, and continuous improvement.
* Collaborate with architects and engineers to build reusable integration capabilities.
* Contribute to platform standards, best practices, and technical mentoring.

**What should you have:**  

* Bachelors degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field.
* 7 years of software engineering or system integration experience.
* 4 years of hands-on MuleSoft CloudHub 2.0 and Anypoint Runtime Fabric (RTF) experience.
* Strong knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, XML, OAuth2, API Security, and integration patterns.
* Experience integrating enterprise applications and cloud platforms.

Site supervision, quantity surveying, or project coordination only.

Limited exclusively to concrete or exclusively to steel.

Reliance on software outputs without understanding assumptions, boundary conditions, and structural behaviour.

About Invicta-Tech

Invicta-Tech is a digital design and construction advisory firm specialising in BIM and technology-driven delivery for complex projects across KSA and the GCC. We work with contractors, consultants and asset owners to turn models, drawings and point clouds into measurable, client-ready deliverables aligned with ISO 19650, project EIRs and BEPs.

Our work spans BIM production (LOD 200-500), model coordination and clash management, BIM automation and asset handover, across infrastructure & landscape, airports, hospitality, giga projects, industrial and logistics facilities. Our delivery team is based in Hyderabad, India.

About the role

We are seeking a Structural Design Engineer to analyse and design reinforced concrete and structural steel structures, from concept development through detailed design and construction support. The role requires sound engineering judgement, practical knowledge of construction methods, and the ability to deliver safe, coordinated, and economical designs.

You will join our Structural Engineering team and report to our Managing Director.

What you will do

Develop structural schemes and assess suitable framing systems for concrete and steel structures.

Perform structural analysis and design for gravity, wind, seismic, and other applicable loads.

Design reinforced concrete foundations, slabs, beams, columns, walls, and associated structural elements.

Design structural steel members, stability systems, bracing, and connections within the agreed project scope.

Assess strength, stability, deflection, drift, vibration, and other relevant serviceability requirements.

Prepare clear design calculations, structural reports, specifications, and design sketches.

Guide and review structural drawings and models prepared by BIM modellers and detailers.

Coordinate structural requirements with architects, civil and MEP engineers, geotechnical consultants, and contractors.

Review shop drawings, material submissions, and technical queries for compliance with the design intent.

Support site and construction queries remotely (site photos, RFIs and technical queries) and resolve construction issues within the assigned scope.

Follow internal checking procedures and maintain clear records of assumptions, revisions, and design decisions.

What we are looking for (must-have)

3-6 years of hands-on structural design experience.

Bachelor's degree in Civil or Structural Engineering.

Demonstrable hands-on experience designing both reinforced concrete and structural steel structures.

Strong understanding of structural mechanics, load paths, lateral stability, and foundation behaviour.

Working knowledge of the structural codes and loading standards applicable to the project location.

Proficiency in structural analysis software such as ETABS, SAP2000, SAFE, STAAD.Pro, Robot, or equivalent tools appropriate to the work.

Ability to validate software results using independent calculations and engineering judgement.

Practical understanding of concrete reinforcement detailing, steel connections, and constructability.

Ability to read, prepare, and review structural drawings and technical documentation.

Strong coordination skills and clear written and verbal communication.

Ability to manage assigned deliverables, deadlines, and quality requirements.

Experience with Revit, Tekla Structures, and BIM coordination workflows.

Good to know: proficiency in every software package listed is not required; strong capability in relevant tools is sufficient. A postgraduate degree is not mandatory where you demonstrate the required design competence.

Good to have

Master's degree in Structural Engineering.

Professional engineering registration, chartership, or progress toward a relevant qualification.

Experience with connection-design tools such as IDEA StatiCa or equivalent.

Experience with seismic design, dynamic analysis, or complex structural systems.

Knowledge of post-tensioned concrete, composite construction, precast concrete, or long-span steel structures.

Experience assessing and strengthening existing structures.

Site experience and familiarity with fabrication, erection, and temporary stability considerations.

Ability to automate calculations or repetitive tasks using spreadsheets, Python, or other suitable tools.

Experience optimising material quantities and evaluating alternative structural solutions.

Success in this role

Success means delivering accurate, well-documented designs on schedule, producing coordinated and buildable solutions, and resolving technical issues with sound engineering judgement.

What we offer

Hands-on design work on live projects from day one.

A small, senior team where your work is visible.

Competitive pay based on experience.

Location and work mode

Hyderabad, India. Full-time, on-site in our design office.

How to apply

Apply here on Indeed with your CV. Your CV must list the concrete and steel structures you designed, the analysis software you used, and your role on each. In your application, tell us briefly about one structure you designed: the structural system, the loads that governed, and how you checked the software results. Do not share client-confidential files.

Pay: ₹65,000.00 - ₹105,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Technical Architect - Associate Architect
description:
**Product Architect**

**Consulting | Product Engineering / Cloud & AI**

**About the Role**

The Product Architect is responsible for defining and governing the end-to-end architecture strategy across cloud, data, AI/ML, and application platforms within a product or offering portfolio. This is an 8-10 year role based in India / USI.

This role operates at the intersection of business strategy and engineering execution, translating client and product objectives into scalable, secure, and compliant target-state architectures. The Product Architect ensures alignment with Deloitte engineering standards, DevSecOps practices, and industry regulatory requirements while enabling high-quality, enterprise-grade delivery. The role requires deep technical expertise, strong stakeholder management, and the ability to influence across product, engineering, security, and client leadership teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Architecture Strategy & Governance**

* Define and maintain target-state architecture for products and platforms across cloud, AI, data, and application layers
* Develop architecture roadmaps aligned to product vision, client requirements, and market strategy
* Establish and enforce architecture standards, reference architectures, and design principles
* Lead architecture review boards and document technical decision records
* Ensure alignment with Deloitte technology risk, security, and compliance frameworks

**Cloud & Application Architecture**

* Design secure cloud landing zones (IAM, network segmentation, logging, monitoring, cost controls)
* Architect multi-tenant and single-tenant SaaS platforms
* Define scalable microservices, API-first, and event-driven architectures
* Ensure non-functional requirements (scalability, resilience, performance, availability, DR) are embedded early in design
* Provide hands-on architectural guidance for cloud-native implementations (AWS/Azure/GCP)

**AI/ML & Data Architecture**

* Architect end-to-end AI/ML solutions from ingestion and feature engineering to model deployment and monitoring
* Define MLOps standards (model registry, CI/CD integration, reproducibility, drift detection)
* Establish data architecture standards including modeling, lineage, governance, access control, and retention
* Implement RBAC and fine-grained security models across data and application layers
* Ensure AI solutions comply with responsible AI, privacy, and regulatory expectations

**DevSecOps & Engineering Excellence**

* Drive DevSecOps adoption including IaC, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and secure release practices
* Embed security controls (SAST/DAST, secrets management) into the SDLC
* Promote SRE and observability practices across product teams
* Identify and mitigate architectural risks, technical debt, and systemic dependencies

**Stakeholder & Team Leadership**

* Partner with Product Owners, Engineering Leads, Security, and Client stakeholders to resolve architectural trade-offs
* Communicate complex technical concepts to executive audiences and delivery teams
* Mentor engineers and junior architects to elevate architectural maturity
* Contribute to proposals, RFP responses, and client solutioning as required
* Support capability development within the practice through knowledge sharing and reusable assets

**Reporting Relationships**

Reports to the Product Engineering Leader / Offering Architect. Partners with Product Owners, Engineering Leads, Security, and Client stakeholders to resolve architectural trade-offs, and mentors engineers and junior architects across the practice.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* 8-10 years of experience in software engineering and/or architecture roles
* Demonstrated experience delivering production-grade cloud-native solutions
* Strong expertise in distributed systems and enterprise application design
* Hands-on experience operationalizing AI/ML solutions and implementing MLOps
* Experience with enterprise data architecture and governance frameworks
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives across product and delivery teams
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent

**Preferred**

* Deployment experience with GCP VertexAI/ AWS Bedrock
* Cloud Architect certifications (AWS/Azure/GCP)
* Experience working in regulated environments (Healthcare, Financial Services, Government)
* Exposure to Zero Trust security models and enterprise compliance frameworks
* Experience contributing to reusable accelerators, frameworks, or IP

**Core Competencies**

**Technical Excellence**

* Cloud architecture (IAM, networking, compute, storage, observability)
* Application architecture (microservices, APIs, integration patterns)
* AI/ML architecture and MLOps
* Data governance and RBAC
* DevSecOps and infrastructure as code

**Leadership & Impact**

* Influence without authority
* Executive-level communication and storytelling
* Risk identification and mitigation
* Coaching and talent development
* Structured problem-solving and decision-making

**Collaboration & Market Impact**

* Cross-functional collaboration
* Client-facing architectural advisory
* Contribution to practice development and thought leadership

**Why This Role Matters**

Every product is only as strong as the architecture underneath it, and this role owns that foundation end-to-end. Success shows up as scalable, secure, production-ready architecture aligned to product and client strategy; reduced architectural risk and improved engineering quality; broad adoption of engineering standards and governance processes; and a growing library of Deloitte IP, accelerators, and reusable architecture assets that make every future product easier to build well.

**Our purpose**

  
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

**Our people and culture**

  
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

**Professional development**

  
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India.

**Benefits to help you thrive**

At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

**Recruiting tips**

  
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

title: Architect - FDE
description:
**Architect - Forward Deployed Engineering**

### **Location**: Hyderabad, India **Employment Type:** Full-Time; Salaried **Compensation:** Base Salary, Bonus, Medical

Job Description
===============

### **About Us**

Innovapptive is a **category-defining SaaS company** building the world’s most advanced **AI-powered Connected Worker Platform** for the industrial sector. Headquartered in Houston, TX, and backed by **Vista Equity Partners**, Innovapptive is on a mission to **reimagine how industrial work gets done** — connecting frontline workers, back-office systems, and assets in real time to drive higher safety, reliability, and productivity.

Our platform is trusted by some of the world’s largest enterprises — including **Shell, Hess, Cenovus Energy, W.R.Grace, Westlake Chemicals, UNICEF, Kimberly Clark, Scott Miracle Gro, and Newmont Mining** to name a few, and across chemicals, energy, mining, and manufacturing industries. These enterprises have achieved tangible, hard-dollar results, such as:

* Over **$40 million in annual EBITDA savings** at a single enterprise.
* **10× frontline productivity improvements** through mobile-first and AI-enabled workflows.
* **15–20% maintenance cost reductions** and **significant uptime gains** across plants and sites.

Innovapptive is recognized by leading industry analysts for its differentiated value creation model:

* Named a **Leader in the Frost & Sullivan Industrial Connected Worker Radar.**
* Featured by **Gartner** in “Connected Factory Worker” research and the **Hype Cycle for Manufacturing Operations Strategy.**
* Cited by **LNS Research** for delivering **3–5× greater value** than point solutions through unified OT–IT execution, AI/vision innovation, and field-proven ROI.

Our growth is backed by **Tiger Global Management and Vista Equity Partners**, one of the world’s premier software investors, known for scaling high-performance SaaS companies. Together, we are building the next-generation AI Powered Connected Worker Platform, combining cutting-edge technologies — SLM’s, Generative AI, Computer Vision, and Intelligent Orchestration — into a unified system that transforms plant operations globally.

Today, with over **300+ employees across the U.S., India, and ANZ**, Innovapptive stands at a pivotal inflection point: with an ambition to scale to **$100M ARR within the next 3-4 years** by industrializing every aspect of our product, engineering, and customer delivery systems.

  

### **About the Team**

Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) is Innovapptive's technical team embedded directly with customers. You'll be part of a small, senior architecture group responsible for how the Innovapptive platform fits into each customer's enterprise landscape — from the first technical conversation through go-live and beyond.

  

### **The Opportunity**

As an Architect, you'll own the technical architecture for how Innovapptive integrates into a customer's enterprise environment — their ERP, their infrastructure, their security model. You'll be the technical thread on your accounts from the first conversation through production, not a pre-sales-only resource.

  

### **How You Will Make An Impact**

* Own technical architecture and enterprise fitment for assigned customer accounts
* Design integration, deployment, and security architecture spanning Innovapptive's platform and the customer's existing systems (SAP, IBM Maximo, middleware, identity/security, cloud infrastructure)
* Support technical evaluations for prospective customers, and stay engaged with the account through deployment and stabilization
* Partner closely with field engineering from the start of an engagement through go-live
* Participate in architecture governance and review processes to keep designs consistent across customers
* Make technical trade-off calls spanning our platform and customer environments
* Mentor engineers on architecture patterns as they deploy and support the platform in the field

### **What You Bring to the Team:**

* 10+ years in enterprise architecture, solutions architecture, or technical pre-sales for complex B2B/enterprise software
* Deep experience with integration architecture — APIs, middleware, data pipelines — and enterprise systems such as SAP or IBM Maximo
* Working knowledge of identity, security, and network architecture in enterprise and cloud environments
* Comfortable owning technical decisions directly with customer architects and IT leadership
* Experience staying engaged with an account beyond the sales cycle — through deployment and stabilization

### **Nice to Have**

* Experience with industrial or asset-intensive customers (manufacturing, utilities, oil & gas, EAM)
* Familiarity with mobile and offline-first application architecture

### **What We Offer above work:**

* Competitive compensation
* Exceptional health, vision, and dental care
* A positive, open, and highly-innovative environment and team.
* Entrepreneurial spirit with unlimited opportunity to grow.
* Opportunity to work with leading global brands on exciting and impactful projects.
* Competitive Base Pay.
* Best of plan on Vacation & Paid Time Off.
* Provision of Medical Insurance for family - self, dependent, spouse, dependent children, parents/parent-in-laws.
* Paid Maternity and Paternity leave.
* Bi-annual reviews to ensure transparency and promote high performance culture.
* OKR Driven Performance Development Environment.
* Learning & Development - access to a wide range of e-Learning courses (technical, Product, Process, etc.,).
* A host of Interest Groups/Clubs for Book Reading, Toastmasters, Sports - Cricket, Volleyball, Throw-ball, Badminton, TT, Music.

**Innovapptive does not accept and will not review unsolicited resumes from search firms.**

Innovapptive is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or creed, alienage or citizenship status, political affiliation, marital or partnership status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, veteran status, gender, gender identity, pregnancy, childbirth (or related medical conditions), sex, sexual orientation, sexual and other reproductive health decisions, genetic disorder, genetic predisposition, carrier status, military status, familial status, or domestic violence victim status and any other basis protected under federal, state, or local laws.

Job Description
===============

### **About Us**

Innovapptive is a **category-defining SaaS company** building the world’s most advanced **AI-powered Connected Worker Platform** for the industrial sector. Headquartered in Houston, TX, and backed by **Vista Equity Partners**, Innovapptive is on a mission to **reimagine how industrial work gets done** — connecting frontline workers, back-office systems, and assets in real time to drive higher safety, reliability, and productivity.

* **15–20% maintenance cost reductions** and **significant uptime gains** across plants and sites.

* Named a **Leader in the Frost & Sullivan Industrial Connected Worker Radar.**
* Featured by **Gartner** in “Connected Factory Worker” research and the **Hype Cycle for Manufacturing Operations Strategy.**
* Cited by **LNS Research** for delivering **3–5× greater value** than point solutions through unified OT–IT execution, AI/vision innovation, and field-proven ROI.

Our growth is backed by **Tiger Global Management and Vista Equity Partners**, one of the world’s premier software investors, known for scaling high-performance SaaS companies. Together, we are building the next-generation AI Powered Connected Worker Platform, combining cutting-edge technologies — SLM’s, Generative AI, Computer Vision, and Intelligent Orchestration — into a unified system that transforms plant operations globally.

Today, with over **300+ employees across the U.S., India, and ANZ**, Innovapptive stands at a pivotal inflection point: with an ambition to scale to **$100M ARR within the next 3-4 years** by industrializing every aspect of our product, engineering, and customer delivery systems.

### **The Opportunity**

When a technician in a refinery, a mine, or a chemical plant opens one of our apps, they are trusting that it works, every time, on a shift where the stakes are real. As a **Staff Engineer**, you are one of the people who earns that trust.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will not manage a team on an org chart. You will lead through the quality of your designs, the depth of your code, and the engineers you make better. You will own the technical direction of major areas of our Mobile and Web platform, set the engineering bar for the teams around you, and turn ambiguous business problems into simple, scalable, dependable solutions.

You will work across our product suite and across the stack, from Node.js microservices and data models to Angular/React and React Native experiences, on AWS. You will also help us bring AI-enabled capabilities into products that frontline workers use every day.

We believe quality depends on the people making the design decisions. At Staff level, you own the "-ilities": scalability, reliability, security, performance, and maintainability. You build them into the design instead of testing them afterwards.

### **How You Will Make An Impact**

* **Own architecture and design.** Lead the design of complex, cross-team features and platform capabilities. Write clear HLDs and LLDs, drive design reviews, and make the trade-offs explicit.
* **Build what matters, hands-on.** Write production-grade code in Node.js, MongoDB/DynamoDB, and Angular or React (including React Native) for the hardest, highest-impact problems. You lead from the code.
* **Design APIs and microservices that last.** Define RESTful and OData API contracts, service boundaries, and data models that scale across customers, industries, and SAP and IBM Maximo integrations.
* **Raise the engineering bar.** Set standards for code quality, testing, CI/CD, observability, and documentation. Use tools like SonarQube and strong unit and integration testing so that quality is measurable.
* **Be the multiplier.** Mentor Senior Engineers and Leads, grow future architects, and make every design and code review a teaching moment.
* **Drive reliability and performance.** Own the non-functional requirements of your area. Lead root-cause analysis on complex production issues and fix the system, not just the symptom.
* **Deploy with confidence.** Shape how we ship on AWS (and Azure/GCP where needed) with Docker, Kubernetes, and modern DevOps practices.
* **Partner across the company.** Work closely with Product Managers, Product Owners, UX designers, QE, and Engineering leadership on vision, planning, and high-level estimates. Join customer conversations when a hard problem needs the right answer.
* **Shape our AI-enabled future.** Help integrate AI services into our products responsibly, and bring a pragmatic view of what works in industrial environments.
* **Stay curious.** Evaluate emerging technologies and bring the ones that make our products and our teams better.

**What You Bring to the Team:**

**Key Qualifications**
----------------------

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* **10–12 years** of full stack engineering experience, with a track record of delivering multiple major releases of SaaS products.
* Deep expertise in **Node.js** and **MongoDB / DynamoDB**, including data modelling and performance optimization.
* Strong proficiency in **Angular or React**; experience with **React Native** or mobile (hybrid/native) applications is a strong plus.
* Proven experience designing **RESTful / OData APIs and microservices architectures** at scale.
* Hands-on experience with **AWS** (Azure/GCP a plus), **Docker and Kubernetes**, and setting up or driving **CI/CD**.
* A history of technical leadership: leading designs, mentoring engineers, and influencing without authority.
* A quality mindset: unit testing, code quality tooling (e.g., SonarQube), security, observability, and performance as part of everyday engineering.

title: Staff Enterprise Integrations Analyst*
description:
**Description**

We are seeking a hands-on Technical Lead / Architect to own the architecture and technical direction of enterprise data, integration, and automation platforms built around Snowflake, AWS, Salesforce, APIs, and modern cloud technologies.This is not a purely advisory architecture role. The ideal candidate is a strong technical builder who can translate business requirements into scalable architectures, establish engineering standards, make key technology decisions, and work directly with engineers to deliver production-grade solutions.You will provide technical leadership across data engineering, system integrations, APIs, cloud infrastructure, security, and enterprise applications. You will work closely with Data Engineers, Integration Engineers, AI Engineers, Product Managers, Security, and business stakeholders to build reliable platforms that connect enterprise systems and make trusted data available across the organization.

**What You'll Do**

### **AWS & Cloud Architecture**

* Drive standardization of logging, tracing, alerting, and error-handling patterns

* Partner with Security and Compliance teams on enterprise controls
* Define availability, reliability, backup, disaster recovery, and operational support standards
* Establish architecture and engineering practices that support production observability and incident response

* Define CI/CD, automated testing, deployment, and release-management practices
* Create technical documentation, architecture diagrams, decision records, and implementation standards

* 3+ years in a Technical Lead, Staff Engineer, Principal Engineer, or Solution Architect capacity
* Strong hands-on experience with Snowflake and modern data architectures
* Strong AWS architecture and engineering experience
* Experience integrating Salesforce with enterprise data and application platforms
* Strong understanding of REST APIs, event-driven architecture, distributed systems, and integration patterns
* Experience designing scalable ETL/ELT and data-processing platforms
* Strong SQL skills and working knowledge of Python

title: Delivery Director
description:
We are Two Circles. We are a Sports & Entertainment Marketing business. We grow audiences and revenues by knowing fans best.

We work with clients to help them understand and influence fan behaviour — how fans spend their money, the events they attend, the channels they respond to, and the content they engage with. We use this understanding to help our clients grow both direct-to-consumer and business-to-business revenues.

Our platforms and services are trusted by over 1,000 clients globally, including the English Premier League, Red Bull, UEFA, VISA, the NFL, Nike and Amazon. We are over 1,000 people, based across 15 offices worldwide, delivering work for sports and entertainment organisations of all shapes and sizes.

India is a long-term commitment for Two Circles. We're already trusted by the BCCI, one of the biggest and most important properties in world sport, and our Hyderabad office sits at the heart of that relationship. Being here, and succeeding here, is central to how we build a better future for the sports and entertainment industry globally.

Hyderabad is a Two Circles office, not a GCC. Today it's tech-centric, but our ambition is to diversify what we build here over time, growing into a broad Two Circles presence rather than staying confined to technology propositions.

We're looking for a Delivery Director to lead our Hyderabad delivery organisation: a team of around 50 engineers, QA and delivery specialists, and still growing. This is a hands-on leadership role, not a governance role sitting apart from the work. You'll take direct ownership of how delivery runs day to day, build a high-performing team, and set the tone for its spirit.

You'll report to our APAC Managing Director, with a dotted line to our Engineering Directors for Data and for Digital Products & CRM, who hold technical direction for their respective practices. As the most senior Two Circles leader in Hyderabad, you'll also play an important role in our work with BCCI, our most important partner in India.

We want Hyderabad to be known, by 2029, not just for delivering the work, but for shaping it, owning it, and making it better. That means more ownership of outcomes, greater exposure to our clients and their problems, more leaders and careers built from within Hyderabad, and a reputation for ideas, innovation and smart use of AI, all while protecting the spirit and connection that makes Two Circles what it is as we grow. You'll be the person most accountable for getting us there.

Leading the Team and Its Spirit

* Lead, grow and retain the India delivery team, including recruitment, onboarding and development of new team members.
* Co-own the spirit of our Hyderabad office with our HR Lead. You'll treat this as a core part of your job, not something handed off to the HR team. You will be the role model of Two Circles spirit in the office.
* Build an India leadership layer of Engineering Managers, QA leadership and delivery leadership. Embed progression frameworks, career pathways and regular, structured feedback.
* Be a visible, accessible leader in the office. Build strong relationships and encourage the face-to-face collaboration that builds trust and improves delivery.

Delivery and Engineering Excellence

* Own the software delivery lifecycle across India projects, with consistent processes that drive quality and predictability.
* Oversee QA and release management standards across India builds, aligned with our global standards.
* Stay close to the work: attend key governance forums, review delivery health weekly, and step in when projects need support.
* Partner with our Tech Leads and Engineering Directors to ensure technical standards and architectural approaches are followed and executed well.
* Embed the agentic engineering practices being rolled out across our global teams. Drive adoption in India and share what you learn.
* Help the India team take increasing ownership of outcomes end-to-end, including design, not just execution, and reduce reliance on other regions to unblock problems.

Performance, Metrics and Governance

* Create and run a monthly governance process and health report for the India team, covering hiring, onboarding, attrition, utilisation, quality, performance and progress on major initiatives.
* Own delivery, quality and team health metrics, including code quality, production defects and time to resolve issues. Track how project leaders elsewhere in the business rate the India team's work.
* Own utilisation and cost efficiency across India delivery. Propose the India hiring plan and work with Delivery Directors globally on resource planning and hotspots.
* Keep any scorecard or metrics simple and supportive, not a tool that creates pressure. Psychological safety and performance measurement need to be built together, not treated as separate things.

Client Leadership

* Act as Client Lead for BCCI: our most senior relationship owner in India, accountable for client governance and margin efficiency. We'd expect this to take up roughly 10% of your time.
* Represent our engineering and delivery capability in client meetings in India, drawing on the work we deliver globally.

Global Collaboration

* Give leadership upward visibility, and give teams clarity on priorities, outcomes and decisions.
* Work with Directors in Melbourne, London and Vancouver to develop operating models that let teams work smoothly across regions.
* Help Hyderabad become a knowledge hub, not just a delivery team: bring in what's working well from London, Melbourne and Vancouver, and feed Hyderabad's own innovations back out to the rest of the business.
* Work effectively across time zones and cultures, bringing structure and clarity to complex, global work.

What Success Looks Like in Your First Year

* A high-performing team, shown in hard metrics such as code quality, production defects and time to resolve issues, and in strong feedback from the project leaders the team works with across regions.
* A strong spirit in our Hyderabad office, measured against our regular pulse checks.
* Our agentic engineering practices widely adopted across the India team.
* A clear monthly view of the India team's health, shared with the wider business through a regular governance process.
* An India leadership layer in place that can support continued growth.

  
**Requirements**

Proven experience building, scaling and leading complex delivery organisations at scale (50+ people) spanning engineering, QA and delivery, including experience managing managers.

* A delivery and operator mindset first. Genuine fluency across data and digital product engineering, sufficient to work credibly with Tech Leads and architects on trade-offs, quality and risk, without requiring a hands-on engineering background yourself.
* Senior client-facing experience in a services, agency or consultancy business.
* Experience working within a multi-region or global delivery model.
* Hands-on ownership of the software delivery lifecycle, delivery processes, resourcing and talent management.
* A demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders without formal authority, across technical, commercial and client audiences.
* An interest in AI-enabled development practices and the drive to lead their adoption.
* Fluent in English, written and spoken.
* Eligible to work in India.

Nice to Have

* A formal delivery or PMO background, or certification (Scrum, PRINCE2 or equivalent).
* Familiarity with the platforms we build on (CMS, identity, video, CRM and e-commerce) and modern cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure or Google Cloud.

Location and Travel

Based in Hyderabad or willing to relocate to Hyderabad.

Able to travel to Vancouver, London, and Melbourne twice a year.
