Job Family Summary:

  

P\&G was founded over 180 years ago as a simple soap and candle company. Today, we're the world’s largest consumer goods company and home to iconic, trusted brands that make life a little bit easier in small but meaningful ways. We've spanned three centuries thanks to three simple ideas: leadership, innovation and citizenship. The insight, innovation and passion of hardworking teams have helped us grow into a global company that is governed responsibly and ethically, that is open and visible, and that supports good causes and protects the environment. This is a place where you can be proud to work and do something that matters.

**Dedication from Us:** You'll be at the core of breakthrough innovations, be given exciting assignments, lead initiatives, and take ownership and responsibility, in creative workspaces where new insights thrive. All the while, you'll receive outstanding training to help you become a leader in your field. It is not just about what you'll do, but how you'll feel: encouraged, valued, purposeful, challenged, heard, and inspired.

**What we Offer:** Continuous mentorship – you will collaborate with peers and receive both formal training as well as day\-to\-day mentoring from your manager dynamic and encouraging work environment– employees are at the center, we value every individual and support initiative, promoting agility and work/life balance.


The Data Architecture job family involves leading the data design for an application, solution, or business domain, helping to define how data will flow, and be stored and structured.


We are looking for an Architect to join our Supply Chain Innovation organization and lead the design of enterprise\-scale Generative AI solutions that run on top of P\&G's data platform. At P\&G, AI is not a standalone experiment — it is an operational interface over the data that runs our business, from supply chain and vendor systems to retail distribution and consumer insights. In this role you will own the architecture for how our AI systems retrieve, reason over, and act on enterprise data, working hands\-on while setting the standards other engineering teams build against. This is an exciting opportunity for a self\-motivated architect who enjoys solving complex technical problems and delivering high\-impact global solutions.


Key Responsibilities:

* Own end\-to\-end architecture for enterprise GenAI solutions — retrieval, orchestration, integration, and evaluation — ensuring they are scalable, secure, and aligned to business outcomes.
* Design production retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) architectures over enterprise data, including document ingestion and chunking, indexing strategy, hybrid lexical and semantic retrieval, re\-ranking, and relevance tuning.
* Architect multi\-phase agent and tool\-calling workflows with deterministic guardrails — scoped tool access, structured output schemas, validation, bounded retries, explicit completion contracts, and fallback handling — so that non\-deterministic models meet production reliability standards.
* Design the data ingestion and synchronization foundations that support AI grounding — streaming and change data capture from enterprise sources, canonical data models, and incremental sync that keeps indexes and downstream systems current.
* Enforce data governance and strict multi\-tenant isolation boundaries across brands, regions, and partners, applying access control, PII protection, and Responsible AI principles by default.
* Establish evaluation and observability standards for AI workloads — curated test sets, automated quality scoring including model\-based judging, regression suites in CI/CD, and end\-to\-end tracing of model behavior in production.
* Own the operational economics of AI systems: latency and throughput targets, inference and token cost management, caching strategies, and routing work to the appropriate model for the task.
* Act as the principal technical authority for AI architecture — lead design reviews, resolve complex performance and integration issues, mentor engineers, and champion Agile, DevOps, and CI/CD practices.


Ideal Candidate:

* A hands\-on architect who can independently design end\-to\-end solutions while remaining active in development, code review, and production problem\-solving.
* Treats AI systems as distributed data systems — designs for failure, latency, duplication, and drift rather than assuming the happy path.
* Collaborative and self\-motivated, able to work across global teams, influence stakeholders without formal authority, and translate business needs into scalable technical solutions.

 **About us**


We produce globally recognized brands, and we grow the best business leaders in the industry. With a portfolio of trusted brands as diverse as ours, it is paramount our leaders are able to lead with courage the vast array of brands, categories and functions. We serve consumers around the world with one of the strongest portfolios of trusted, quality, leadership brands, including Always®, Ariel®, Gillette®, Head \& Shoulders®, Herbal Essences®, Oral\-B®, Pampers®, Pantene®, Tampax® and more. Our community includes operations in approximately 70 countries worldwide.


Visit http://www.pg.com to know more.


We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate against individuals on the basis of race, color, gender, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, citizenship, disability, HIV/AIDS status, or any other legally protected factor

**Job Qualifications**


Job Qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 10\+ years of experience in software engineering, with a significant focus on architecture and technical leadership of large\-scale, multi\-tenant, or high\-throughput platforms.
* Hands\-on experience designing and delivering production Generative AI solutions — retrieval\-augmented generation, LLM\-based classification and extraction, or multi\-phase agent workflows — including the schema validation, guardrails, and fallback logic that make them dependable.
* Proven experience architecting orchestration layers for distributed systems — event\-driven and streaming pipelines, workflow and state management, idempotency, bounded retries, and recovery from partial failure — and applying the same discipline to AI and agent workflows.
* Strong grounding in search and retrieval: inverted indexes and lexical relevance scoring, vector and semantic similarity, hybrid retrieval and rank fusion, re\-ranking, and the effect of data freshness on retrieval quality.
* Experience defining quality and evaluation practices for probabilistic systems — curated test sets, regression suites, automated and model\-based scoring of output quality, and production tracing.


 Experience integrating heterogeneous enterprise systems and data sources at scale across streaming, API, and file\-based patterns, with strong data modeling and schema governance instincts. programming skills in at least one backend language (Python, Node.js/TypeScript, or similar), with hands\-on experience across document and relational data stores.

* Cloud\-native engineering experience (Azure) with containerization, CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and observability as default practice.
* Ability to lead technical design discussions, drive solution decisions, and operate as a hands\-on technical lead within cross\-functional and global teams.
* Strong verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with technical and business stakeholders.


Preferred: Working knowledge of modern lakehouse platforms (Databricks, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog) and medallion data architectures; familiarity with AI governance, guardrails, and evaluation tooling; experience integrating enterprise systems; experience designing for regulated or highly sensitive data environments.

description:
**This role is for one of our clients**  

  

Company Name: Incepteo  

Industry: Information Technology \& Services  

Seniority level: Mid\-Senior level

Experience: 5\+ yrs



Location: Hyderabad, Telangana, India



Job Type: Full\-time



Senior Technical Lead – Product Releases \& Engineering


**Role Purpose**
----------------



We are looking for a mature, hands\-on Senior Technical Lead who can bring structure, predictability and ownership to the engineering and release process for Stratpilot.



The role sits between the Product Owner, Delivery Manager, Technical Architect and engineering team. Your primary responsibility is to ensure that multiple developers, features and code changes come together into stable, well\-coordinated product releases.



This is not simply a senior developer role and it is not a purely managerial position. You must remain technically hands\-on while taking ownership of release coordination, engineering discipline and day\-to\-day technical delivery.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


**Release Management**
----------------------



You will coordinate releases across Development Test / QA UAT Production Monitoring.


* Coordinate release scope with the Product Owner and Delivery Manager, maintaining visibility of features, fixes and dependencies.


* Ensure development, code reviews, integration and testing are completed before release and conduct technical release\-readiness checks.


* Coordinate application, API, database and configuration changes; manage release branches, versioning, hotfixes and production fixes.


* Coordinate deployments across Dev, Test, UAT and Production, support UAT issue resolution and provide technical Go / No\-Go recommendations.


* Ensure rollback or recovery procedures are understood, validate Production releases and coordinate post\-release issue resolution.



The objective is to create a repeatable, controlled and increasingly automated release process rather than relying on individual developers or last\-minute effort.


**Engineering Team Coordination**
---------------------------------


* Maintain visibility of development progress and identify dependencies across frontend, backend, database and integrations.


* Ensure developers understand requirements and technical expectations; identify blockers and risks early.


* Coordinate work where features cross multiple components, help resolve difficult technical issues and review progress against sprint and release commitments.


* Escalate architectural concerns to the Technical Architect, delivery risks to the Delivery Manager, and work with the Product Owner where requirements need clarification.



The successful candidate should bring structure without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.


**Engineering Maturity \& Quality**
-----------------------------------



You will help strengthen:


* Pull\-request and code\-review discipline; Git branching, merge management, release branching and versioning.


* Definition of Done, release\-readiness criteria, automated build/test/deployment, code coverage and automated testing.


* Environment management, logging and monitoring, technical documentation, incident management and root\-cause analysis.


* Technical\-debt management and secure development practices.



You will ensure code produced by different developers is properly reviewed, consolidated and integrated before entering shared environments.


**Hands\-On Technical Capability**
----------------------------------



Although release and team coordination are the main focus, this remains a hands\-on technical leadership role. You should be comfortable working across React / React.js, Python, REST APIs and backend services, MySQL or similar relational databases, Git and GitHub, GitHub Actions / CI/CD, Google Cloud Platform, authentication and authorisation, SaaS integrations, logging, monitoring and production troubleshooting.

  



Strong, practical experience with Google Cloud Platform and GitHub is vital for this role. You should have hands\-on experience using Google Cloud services to deploy, operate, monitor and troubleshoot production SaaS applications, and be confident managing GitHub repositories, pull requests, branching strategies, code reviews, permissions and GitHub Actions\-based CI/CD workflows.



You should be capable of reviewing code, challenging implementation decisions and stepping into complex technical or production issues when necessary.

  



Experience with AI applications, LLMs, agents, RAG, MCP, LangGraph/LangChain, OpenAI, Claude or Gemini would be advantageous.


**Production \& Incident Management**
-------------------------------------


* Assess incident severity and impact, coordinate developers during investigation and identify root causes.


* Manage hotfixes and emergency releases, communicate technical status clearly and validate systems following fixes.


* Conduct root\-cause reviews and ensure preventative actions are completed.



We are looking for someone who remains calm, methodical and accountable under pressure.


**Experience We Are Looking For**
---------------------------------



Ideally, you will have 5\+ years of software engineering experience with meaningful technical leadership responsibility in a production SaaS environment, including:


* Coordinating development teams and managing SaaS releases into Production across Dev, Test, UAT and Production environments.


* Google Cloud deployment, operations, monitoring and troubleshooting.


* GitHub repository, branch, pull\-request and permissions management, including GitHub Actions and CI/CD automation.


* Release\-readiness, deployment processes, code consolidation and strong code\-review practices.


* Production incident resolution, cross\-functional working with Product Owners, architects and delivery managers, and continuous engineering process improvement.



We are particularly interested in candidates who have personally owned these responsibilities, rather than simply participated within a team where others managed releases and coordination.


**Leadership Maturity**
-----------------------


* Ownership – takes responsibility and drives outcomes.


* Judgement – knows when to proceed, challenge or escalate.


* Organisation – keeps multiple developers and dependencies coordinated.


* Communication – explains technical issues clearly.


* Composure – remains effective during releases and incidents.


* Constructive leadership – guides developers without micromanaging.


* Quality mindset – balances speed with reliability.


* Continuous improvement – strengthens processes after every release.


**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------


* More predictable and controlled releases with clear ownership and readiness criteria.


* Better engineering coordination with earlier visibility of blockers and dependencies.


* Stronger GitHub, PR, code\-review, testing and CI/CD discipline and more reliable Google Cloud operations.


* Fewer release\-related defects and last\-minute integration issues, with faster Production incident resolution.


* Improved engineering maturity and reduced dependency on individual heroics.

  


**In one sentence: Your responsibility is to turn multiple developers, features and code changes into one coordinated engineering team delivering stable, high\-quality SaaS releases consistently for the Stratpilot venture, using strong GitHub practices and reliable Google Cloud delivery and operations.**

title: Interior Site Supervisor
description:
Job Description – Interior Execution Supervisor

**Industry:** High\-End Turnkey Interior Solutions  
**Location:** Hyderabad  
**Experience Required:** 2–4 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Department:** Project Execution / Operations

Job Overview

We are a high\-end turnkey interior solutions company seeking a proactive, detail\-oriented, and experienced **Interior Execution Supervisor** to manage the on\-site execution of premium residential and commercial interior projects.

The selected candidate will be responsible for supervising day\-to\-day site activities, coordinating vendors and subcontractors, managing labour and materials, maintaining quality standards, monitoring project timelines, and communicating with clients, architects, and consultants.

The ideal candidate should have **3–5 years of hands\-on interior execution experience** and must be capable of independently handling luxury and premium interior project sites.

Key Roles and Responsibilities1\. Site Supervision and Execution

* Supervise the day\-to\-day execution of interior project activities.
* Monitor civil works, electrical works, plumbing, false ceiling, painting, flooring, carpentry, joinery, and other finishing works.
* Ensure all work is carried out according to approved drawings, specifications, and quality standards.
* Plan and allocate daily work activities to site teams and subcontractors.

2\. Vendor, Subcontractor and Labour Coordination

* Coordinate with vendors, skilled labour, subcontractors, and internal project teams.
* Ensure timely deployment of manpower at the project site.
* Monitor labour productivity, attendance, discipline, and quality of work.
* Follow up with subcontractors to ensure activities are completed within the planned timeline.
* Resolve coordination issues between different trades operating at the site.

3\. Material Planning and Management

* Assess and plan daily and weekly material requirements.
* Coordinate procurement requirements with the purchase and project teams.
* Monitor material delivery, storage, consumption, and availability at the site.
* Ensure materials are used efficiently and prevent unnecessary wastage or damage.
* Report material shortages and requirements in advance to avoid execution delays.

4\. Drawing Reading and Design Compliance

* Read and interpret architectural, interior, electrical, plumbing, ceiling, flooring, and furniture drawings.
* Ensure site execution is carried out strictly according to approved drawings and design intent.
* Identify discrepancies between drawings and actual site conditions.
* Coordinate with architects, designers, and project managers for clarification and resolution.

5\. Quality Control and Issue Resolution

* Conduct regular inspections of ongoing and completed works.
* Ensure workmanship, finishes, dimensions, levels, alignment, and installation quality meet company standards.
* Prepare and follow quality checklists for different activities.
* Identify defects, workmanship issues, and execution risks at an early stage.
* Coordinate corrective actions and ensure proper closure of identified issues.
* Proactively resolve site\-level challenges without affecting project quality or timelines.

6\. Client, Architect and Consultant Coordination

* Maintain professional communication with clients, architects, consultants, and other stakeholders.
* Provide regular and accurate updates regarding site progress.
* Attend site meetings and record important discussions, decisions, and action points.
* Address client and consultant observations professionally and ensure timely closure.
* Maintain a client\-focused approach throughout the execution process.

7\. Reporting and Documentation

* Prepare and maintain daily site progress reports.
* Maintain labour attendance, work logs, material records, and subcontractor activity reports.
* Record planned versus completed activities.
* Maintain photographic documentation of site progress and quality inspections.
* Regularly update the company’s project tracking and reporting systems.
* Report site delays, risks, material shortages, and execution concerns to the reporting manager.

8\. Timeline and Delivery Monitoring

* Monitor project activities against the approved execution schedule.
* Ensure daily and weekly targets are achieved.
* Identify potential delays and dependencies in advance.
* Coordinate with internal teams, vendors, and subcontractors to recover delayed activities.
* Support snag rectification, final finishing, client inspection, and timely project handover.

9\. Site Safety, Protection and Cleanliness

* Ensure workers and subcontractors follow site safety requirements.
* Maintain a clean, safe, and organized project site.
* Ensure completed works, furniture, materials, flooring, and fixtures are adequately protected.
* Monitor housekeeping and safe storage of tools and materials.
* Immediately report and address unsafe site conditions.

Required Skills

* Strong interior site supervision and execution capabilities.
* Ability to read and understand architectural and interior drawings.
* Good knowledge of premium interior materials, finishes, and installation methods.
* Strong vendor, subcontractor, and labour coordination skills.
* Effective time, resource, and team management.
* Strong problem\-solving and crisis\-management abilities.
* Good interpersonal and client\-handling skills.
* Strong communication, follow\-up, and reporting abilities.
* Fluency in **English, Hindi, and Telugu**.

Technical KnowledgeInterior Execution and Detailing

* Strong understanding of interior construction processes.
* Knowledge of civil modifications, false ceilings, flooring, painting, electrical works, plumbing, carpentry, joinery, hardware, furniture, and finishing activities.
* Understanding of premium materials, finishes, detailing, and installation standards.
* Knowledge of activity sequencing and dependencies between different interior trades.

Software and Digital Tools

* Basic working knowledge of MS Word, MS Excel, and email communication.
* Ability to use WhatsApp and digital communication tools professionally.
* Ability to access, read, and understand AutoCAD drawings.
* Comfortable using mobile or web\-based project reporting and tracking systems.

Site Documentation

* Ability to prepare daily progress reports and labour reports.
* Experience maintaining work checklists and quality inspection records.
* Ability to maintain photographic documentation of site progress.
* Basic understanding of material tracking and work\-completion reporting.

Desired Professional Attributes

* Self\-motivated and results\-driven.
* Strong ownership mindset and accountability.
* Professional and client\-focused demeanour.
* High attention to detail and finishing quality.
* Organized, punctual, and disciplined.
* Capable of working under pressure and meeting fast\-paced timelines.
* Solution\-oriented and composed during site challenges.
* Strong leadership qualities with the ability to guide site teams.
* Effective team player with good coordination skills.
* Flexible and adaptable to changing site requirements.

Commuting Requirements

* The candidate must own a bike and possess a valid driving licence.
* Must be willing to travel between multiple project sites across Hyderabad, as required.

Candidate Motivation and Mindset

The preferred candidate should:

* Be passionate about high\-end interiors and quality execution.
* Take pride in delivering premium finishes and successful project handovers.
* Be growth\-oriented and willing to continuously learn.
* Be adaptable to evolving project and site conditions.
* Demonstrate a strong commitment to timelines, quality, and client satisfaction.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Diploma or degree in Civil Engineering, Interior Design, Architecture, Construction Management, or a related field.
* 3–5 years of relevant experience in interior site execution.
* Prior experience independently managing premium residential or commercial interior projects.
* Experience working with architects, designers, consultants, vendors, subcontractors, and clients.
* Strong knowledge of execution sequencing, interior detailing, and finishing standards.

 Microsoft Industry Solutions Delivery (ISD) is a global organization hosting over 6,000 strategic sellers, industry and security experts, elite engineers, world\-class data scientists and architects, consultants, and delivery specialists. Together with our partners, we help Microsoft’s most strategic customers worldwide to address their specific challenges and provide comprehensive and industry\-specific solutions that meet their unique needs. ISD is at the forefront of innovation, driving value across the entirety of the customers’ digital and AI transformation journey through repeatable and customized cutting\-edge solutions through strategic engagements with customers across the globe powered by Microsoft Cloud and AI.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 People Management
   

  

 Managers deliver success through empowerment and accountability by modeling, coaching, and caring.
   

  

 Model \- Live our culture. Embody our values. Practice our leadership principles.
   

  

 Coach \- Define team objectives and outcomes. Enable success across boundaries. Help the team adapt and learn.
   

  

 Care \- Attract and retain great people. Know each individual’s capabilities and aspirations. Invest in the growth of others.
   

  

 Understanding Customer/Partner Technical Environment
   

  

 Provides support for their team in gathering and propagating customer/partner insights to help shape and form both the definition and ongoing execution of the project. Holds teams accountable for mapping architecture and digital transformation solutions to customer/partner business goals. Leverages prior work, customer/partner insights, and industry trends, and shares insights with team to apply.
   

  

 Supports their team in working with customer/partner stakeholders (e.g., Enterprise Architects, Security Team, Development Team, Operations Team) and business sponsor to socialize both the business solution and the project approach. Advises team on managing changes and facilitating feedback. Contributes to Microsoft\-centric operations and cadences to align with customer feedback.
   

  

 Drives internal advocacy by facilitating insight sharing with Product Engineering teams, and providing guidance through escalation, acceleration, and prioritization. Looks across multiple customers/partners for opportunities to consolidate and prioritize items across the business. When appropriate, establishes accountabilities to drive customer outcomes and ensure internal stakeholders are in place. Ensures that customer opportunities, questions, and/or issues are brought to the appropriate internal teams.
   

  

 Architecture Design and Deployment
   

  

 Holds teams accountable for leveraging existing architecture approaches to achieve Microsoft's agreed commitments to the customer/partner and developing new solutions to scale across multiple customers/partners and markets. When appropriate, governs areas of fiscal responsibility, through delivery team, staying within budget while driving engagement profitability and risk management.
   

  

 Guides team in defining and documenting the architecture through an architecture description document, an architecture decisions log, and a requirements/constraints traceability matrix. Ensures team is equipped to communicate the value proposition of the business solution along with the project approach. Guides team in cost\-based and technology\-based discussions to explain the architecture in terms of its build, deployment, and ongoing operational use to determine customer appetite for the business solution. Promotes a business\-value approach that values return on investment (ROI) and customer costs\-savings over technical ease of execution. Provides coaching to allow architects to scale solutions. Support new customer opportunities in partnership with Sales with highly significant or global impacts for Microsoft, as needed.
   

  

 Collaborates with the other managers to jointly drive project/technical governance of the design, build, and deployment into use of proof of concepts (POCs) and pilots. Provides guidance to team in understanding and demonstrating business value (e.g., release of revenue, cost savings) that the business solution realizes.
   

  

 Guides team in working with the business sponsor and customer/partner stakeholders (e.g., Business users, Enterprise Architects, Security Team, Operations Team) to gather and ratify requirements and constraints. Supports team in managing and resolving complex ambiguity in the requirements and constraints and documents assumptions and implications where it cannot be resolved. Ensures maintenance of the requirements/constraints traceability matrix to prove that solution components have a rationale/justification for inclusion in the Architecture of the business solution. Oversees development and execution of test plans to prove that each requirement/constraint has been implemented as expected by the customer.
   

  

 Leads team in collaborating to understand the business solution/problem. Drives agreement, based on the customer’s priorities, requirements/constraints, approach, principles, concepts, and expectations. Ensures team builds and documents a realistically costed, advanced/complex solution approach. Provides thought leadership on oversight and governance sets expectations for quality practices and standards to realize the business solution. Promotes a cohesive build methodology so the solution can be transitioned to live operations, leveraging solution expertise. Ensures communication of and adherence to the pre\-sales value proposition. Ensures that customer opportunities, questions, and/or issues are brought to the appropriate internal teams. When appropriate, negotiates, collaborates on, reviews, and contributes to deal approval processes. Challenges deal construct to ensure Microsoft initiatives are incorporated appropriately. Communicates current view of delivery to customer executives on regular cadence, as needed. When appropriate, oversees a broad portfolio of accounts. Manages and ensures the all\-up delivery of consulting engagements, as necessary. Innovates and implements long\-term, strategic plans, in partnership with Sales to create new opportunities and sustainable growth for customer accounts across the portfolio, as needed. Ensures delivery team alignment and holds delivery team accountable for delivering on sales strategy.
   

  

 Creates a culture and clarity around technical insights and escalations, and ensures broad sets of projects move forward. Provides support and guidance to team in identifying scenarios that could slow or impede pre\-sales/delivery. Resolves escalations as needed and coaches team on best practices for handling escalations. Ensures that issues and blockers and addressed by the appropriate groups. Identifies patterns in blockers across business areas or a territory. When necessary, attends steering committee meetings with strategic customers to remove blockers and ensure delivery success.
   

  

 Works in close collaboration with the Project Manager and Account Team to identify, categorize, and communicate business and technical risks. Defines risk mitigation activities that are foundational to the project plan. Defines risk contingency plans for invocation should the risk occur. When appropriate, oversees a broad portfolio of accounts. Manages and ensures the all\-up delivery of consulting engagements, as necessary.
   

  

 Practice Development
   

  

 Generates new and/or improvements to existing intellectual property. Connects gaps and patterns across business and technology areas to drive changes. Identifies which ideas should be culled, with consideration for scale across customers. Drives the re\-use of intellectual property and recommends practices in both pre\-sales and delivery. Participates and contributes to internal/external communities.
   

  

 Trusted Advisor
   

  

 Develops a network of internal/external relationships with senior\-level decision makers to build influence in addressing problems/blockers and facilitating additional views on the matter of interest. Acts as an advisor to external stakeholders. Provides direction to facilitate relationships between others. Stays up to date on Microsoft’s technologies, products, and services in order to communicate Microsoft's mission, strategy, and capabilities. When appropriate, develops a strategic relationship with key stakeholders within the customer portfolio, often as part of a steering committee, to ensure service delivery is on track and major issues are being anticipated, identified, and managed.
   

  

 Coaches team to use evidence\-based arguments that articulate complex concepts in a simple manner to respectfully challenge Microsoft and customers/partners when a decision or course of action will not produce optimal results. Leverages strategic expertise to encourage alternative approaches where applicable. Serves as the "technical conscience" to challenge the status quo and unrealistic expectations. Proactively resolves conflicts and seeks resolution to balance the overall outcome. Drives consensus where possible and leads decisions to resolve conflict when needed and guides team in doing so.
   

  

 Provides their team with a holistic perspective of customer/partner challenges, industry trends, and competitor architectures to allow team members to engage with customers/partners, demonstrate Microsoft's value, and develop counter strategy.
   

  

 Thought Leadership
   

  

 Fosters community sharing of stories and leveraging of pre\-existing resources by encouraging and empowering team to share learnings and by establishing a cadence (e.g., internal technical brainstorming calls, presenting latest challenges in staff meetings) to calibrate on challenges and trends that impact the team across the subsidiary level. Holds teams accountable for sharing insights with v\-team members to inform the direction they take with customers/partners.
   

  

 Participates in external architect community events (e.g., conferences, seminars, technical meetups, Webcasts, blogs, hackathons) and shares learnings with internal team. Acts a mentor to less experienced colleagues by educating them on technical and non\-technical concepts and sharing best practices. Demonstrates deep industry knowledge and drives recognition for Microsoft solutions through presentations and engagements with external audiences.
   

  

**Other**
 Embody our culture and values
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Required/Minimum Qualifications
   

  

 Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 8\+ years' experience in technology solutions, practice development, architecture, consulting, and/or technology domain (e.g., Security)

 OR equivalent experience.
   

  

**Additional Or Preferred Qualifications**

 OR master's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 8\+ years' experience in technology solutions, practice development, architecture, consulting, and/or technology domain (e.g., Security)
   

  

 OR equivalent experience.
   

  

 6\+ years technical sales experience.

 2\+ years managing multiple projects or portfolios.
   

  

 1\+ year(s) experience leading blended, multidisciplinary teams.
   

  

 3\+ years people management experience, including managing consultant practice managers, technical sales managers, and/or technical architect managers.
   

  

 Technical or Professional Certification in Domain (e.g., Security).

description:
**About Us** We are a 3D Architecture and Visualization studio creating high\-quality architectural renders, real\-time walkthroughs, virtual experiences, and interactive environments.

**Responsibilities**

* Create realistic architectural environments in Unreal Engine.
* Import and optimise 3D assets from 3ds Max, SketchUp, or other DCC tools.
* Set up materials, lighting, landscapes, vegetation, and post\-processing.
* Assist in creating real\-time architectural walkthroughs and presentations.
* Maintain visual quality while ensuring performance optimisation.
* Work closely with architects, 3D artists, and project managers.
* Organise and manage project assets efficiently.

**Requirements**

* Basic knowledge of Unreal Engine 5\.
* Understanding of environment creation, lighting, and materials.
* Knowledge of architectural visualisation workflows.
* Familiarity with 3D modelling software (3ds Max, SketchUp, etc.).
* Understanding of PBR materials and rendering principles.
* Basic knowledge of composition, colour theory, and realistic lighting.
* Strong willingness to learn and grow.
* Diploma/Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Animation, Game Art, Multimedia, or related field is preferred.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with Lumen, Nanite, Quixel Megascans.
* Knowledge of Twinmotion.
* Understanding of Datasmith workflow.
* Portfolio showcasing architectural or environment projects.
* Basic Blueprint knowledge.

Pay: ₹11,333\.18 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: PRINCIPAL ENGINEER, AI ARCHITECT, SMAI
description:
**Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for** ***all*****.**

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

**SMAI Story**  

Micron Technology’s vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life, and our commitment to people, innovation, tenacity, collaboration, and customer focus allows us to fulfill our mission to be a global leader in memory and storage solutions. This means conducting business with integrity, accountability, and professionalism while supporting our global community.  

  

Do you believe that data provides groundbreaking insight? Do you see data as an asset that builds a competitive advantage? Great…so do we!  

  

Micron Technology operates in a highly competitive industry where innovation depends on hardworking minds extracting fresh insights from an ever\-expanding data universe. We are seeking a technically strong Solution Architect who can design and build innovative, rock\-solid data science, AI/ML, and Agentic AI solutions for Smart Manufacturing use cases. We have a diverse, collaborative environment where problem solving is a team sport and creative solutions are recognized and rewarded. Does this sound like the right team for you? Apply today!  

  

Solution Architects in this role partner with Data Scientists, AI Engineers, and AI Product Owners to architect scalable and innovative data science solutions in technology domains such as Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), Gen AI, Big Data, and Internet of Things (IoT) using both on prem and cloud\-based platforms.  

  

In this role, you will need to be technically sound and capable of crafting innovative end\-to\-end designs to solve highly complex business problems. We are looking for team members who enjoy learning, introducing new technologies, and building scalable solutions that drive value for the business. The ideal candidate will have significant experience architecting enterprise data and analytics platforms, especially in cloud\-based and hybrid environments, and the ability to dive deep into hands\-on technical solutions while mentoring others through strong technical leadership.

**Roles \& Responsibilities**

* Define and architect scalable, production\-ready cloud analytics, machine learning, and data science solutions to solve highly complex Smart Manufacturing business problems.
* Lead technical architecture decisions that minimize technical debt through robust system design, data models, platform standards, and lifecycle management practices.
* Provide deep subject matter expertise to troubleshoot critical technical issues and drive innovative solutions across multiple projects and pillars.
* Work effectively in cross\-functional teams, tiger teams, and technical working groups to align stakeholders and deliver strong, scalable architecture outcomes.
* Coach and mentor Data Scientists, AI Engineers, and AI Product Owners through technical reviews, knowledge sharing, and solution guidance to elevate overall team capability.

**Qualifications and Experience**

* Overall 15\+ yrs of IT experience in Data technologies with 5\+ years of experience in architecting and delivering large\-scale cloud data analytics and AI/ML solutions, preferably on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or Microsoft Azure and on\-prem enterprise platforms.
* Hands\-on experience with any of the GCP/Azure cloud and popular on\-prem platforms. Expertise in Agentic AI, Gen AI and distributed enterprise computing tech such as OpenShift/Kubernetes, Solace is desired.
* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in Python, .NET, SQL, and modern front\-end technologies such as Angular, with expertise in software engineering and GitHub\-based collaboration practices.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and written communication skills. Great presentation skills, with a high degree of comfort interacting with management, developers, architects, and business stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to adapt to new technologies, learn quickly, and evaluate emerging tools and frameworks to drive innovation and long\-term business value.

**About Micron Technology, Inc.**


We are an industry leader in innovative memory and storage solutions transforming how the world uses information to enrich life *for all*. With a relentless focus on our customers, technology leadership, and manufacturing and operational excellence, Micron delivers a rich portfolio of high\-performance DRAM, NAND, and NOR memory and storage products through our Micron® and Crucial® brands. Every day, the innovations that our people create fuel the data economy, enabling advances in artificial intelligence and 5G applications that unleash opportunities — from the data center to the intelligent edge and across the client and mobile user experience.

title: Sr. Technical Account Manager, ES - INDIA
description:
AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.



Amazon has built a global reputation for being the most customer\-centric company, a company that customers from all over the world recognize, value, and trust for both our products and services. Amazon has a fast\-paced environment where we “Work Hard, Have Fun and Make History.”



As an increasing number of enterprises move their critical systems to the cloud, AWS India is in need of highly efficient technical consulting talent to help our largest and strategically important customers navigate the operational challenges and complexities of AWS Cloud. We are looking for Technical Consultants to support our customers creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Data Analytics, Application services, Networking, Server\-less and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor for organizations ranging from start\-ups to large enterprises.



As a Senior Technical Account Manager, you will be the primary technical point of contact for one or more customers helping to plan, debug, and oversee ongoing operations of business\-critical applications. You will get your hands dirty, troubleshooting application, network, database, and architectural challenges using a suite of internal AWS Cloud tools as well as your existing knowledge and toolkits. We are seeking individuals with strong backgrounds in I.T. Consulting and in any of these related areas such as Solution Designing, Application and System Development, Database Management, Big Data and Analytics, DevOps Consulting, and Media technologies. Knowledge of programming and scripting is beneficial to the role.



Key job responsibilities Every day will bring new and exciting challenges on the job while you:


* You’ll build solutions, provide technical guidance and advocate for the customer
* Ensure AWS environments remain operationally healthy whilst reducing cost and complexity
* Develop trusting relationships with customers, understanding their business needs and technical challenges
* Using your technical acumen and customer obsession, you’ll drive technical discussions regarding incidents, trade\-offs, and risk management
* Consult with a range of partners from developers through to C\-suite executives
* Collaborate with AWS Solutions Architects, Business Developers, Professional Services Consultants, and Sales Account Managers
* With a bias for action, you'll proactively find opportunities for customers to gain additional value from AWS
* Provide detailed reviews of service disruptions, metrics, detailed pre\-launch planning
* Solve a variety of problems across different customers as they migrate their workloads to the cloud
* Uplift customer capabilities by running workshops, brown bag sessions, etc.


Watch a short video about life as a Technical Account Manager here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v\=J\_Rm0QgWvQ8 The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation, come join us!



A day in the life As a Senior TAM, you will help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers’ adoption and use of AWS services \- including EC2, S3, DynamoDB \& RDS databases, Lambda, Bedrock, SageMaker, and many more. Your technical acumen and customer\-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer’s environment, and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade\-offs, support, and risk management. You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices, and proactively keep your customers’ AWS environments operationally healthy. The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges, and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS.



About the team Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.



Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.



Inclusive Team Culture AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.



Mentorship \& Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.



Work/Life Balance We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.


### **Basic Qualifications**


* 7\+ years of hands\-on infrastructure, troubleshooting, systems administration, networking, DevOps or applications development experience
* Knowledge of of cloud based architecture, cloud services and experience in customer facing roles
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, math, or equivalent, or experience in a STEM field equivalent to a four year degree
* Experience in external enterprise customer\-facing role as a technical lead, with strong oral and written communication skills, presenting to both large and small audiences
* Experience in a 24x7 operational services or support environment

### **Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience in internal enterprise or external customer\-facing environment as a technical lead
* Experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
* Experience in one or more of the following areas: software design or development, content distribution/CDN, scripting/automation, database architecture, IP networking, IT security, BigData/Hadoop/Spark, operations management, service oriented architecture


Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit \[https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations](https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations) for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Associate Engineer, Software Development
description:
**Driven by the passion to improve quality of people’s lives, WSA continues to grow as market leader in the hearing aid industry. With our commitment to increase penetration in an underserved hearing care market, we want to accelerate our business transformation in order to reach more people, more effectively.**


We are looking for an **Associate Engineer, Software Development** with strong foundational expertise in Android application development. This role focuses on building, enhancing, and maintaining high\-quality mobile applications while collaborating with cross\-functional teams to deliver innovative and scalable software solutions that create value for customers and the organization.

**What you will do**
--------------------

### **Software Development**

* Develop, maintain, and enhance Android applications using Kotlin and Android Jetpack components.
* Produce efficient, clean, maintainable, and scalable code aligned with architectural guidelines and coding standards.
* Contribute to the design and implementation of software solutions that meet product requirements and business needs.
* Evaluate and integrate third\-party software libraries and components where appropriate.

### **Quality \& Testing**

* Develop and maintain automated tests at unit, integration, and system levels.
* Ensure business\-critical functionality, edge cases, and failure scenarios are appropriately covered.
* Collaborate with software testers to ensure product quality and reliability throughout the development lifecycle.

### **Technical Design \& Continuous Improvement**

* Design solutions aligned with overall architecture and strategic direction.
* Support implementation of core application components and technical enablers.
* Troubleshoot, debug, and improve existing software components to ensure maintainability and performance.
* Identify technical debt and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.

### **Collaboration \& Planning**

* Collaborate with Product Owners, Architects, Software Engineers, and Test Engineers to deliver high\-quality solutions.
* Create technical documentation and contribute to knowledge\-sharing activities.
* Participate in planning, estimation, and iteration activities, identifying technical risks and supporting delivery commitments.

**What you bring**
------------------

### **Experience**

* 1–2 years of experience in software development.
* University degree in Engineering or a related field.
* Experience developing Android applications using Kotlin and Android development frameworks.
* Familiarity with Agile software development methodologies and collaborative engineering practices.

### **Technical Skills**

* Basic knowledge of Kotlin and Java programming languages.
* Strong understanding of Android SDK, APIs, Android Jetpack, and mobile application architecture.
* Knowledge of software engineering principles, object\-oriented programming, clean architecture, and coding best practices.
* Experience with automated testing, debugging, troubleshooting, and application performance optimization.
* Understanding of source control systems and modern software development practices.

### **Personal Competencies**

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Self\-motivated and proactive with the ability to work independently.
* Strong teamwork and collaboration skills.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Passion for continuous learning, emerging technologies, and software craftsmanship.

**Who we are**
--------------


At WSA, we provide innovative hearing aids and hearing health services.


Together with our 12,000 colleagues in 130 countries, we invite you to help unlock human potential by bringing back hearing for millions of people around the world.


With us, you will become part of a truly global company where we care for one another, welcome diversity and celebrate our successes.

**Sounds wonderful? We can't wait to hear from you.**


WSA is an equal\-opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive employee experience for all. Regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, disability, military or veteran status we firmly believe that our work is at its best when everyone feels free to be their most authentic self.
